`blast_partners`, and `blast_boosts_core` are immutable. `blast_fun_migrators`
exposes no way to restrict or seal itself.

**What stops a stale package version from moving funds?** Every protected call
checks the shared generation against the generation compiled into the bytecode,
and the upgrade finalizer advances the generation in the same transaction that
commits the upgrade.

**What does an upgrade leave on chain?** `UpgradeAuthorized` with the exact
digest, `UpgradeCommitted` with the new package ID, and
`OperationalVersionAdvanced` with the new generation, all in one transaction.

**Can someone forge a version bump event?** No. `OperationalVersion<M>` can only
be created with `M`'s one-time witness inside `M`'s package `init`, and only the
module holding it can advance it.

**Does the presale use this ACL?** Yes. `blast_presale_domain` declares six
presale roles, granted like any other package's.

## API reference: `blast_presale` (Presale)

Live on mainnet, published from an earlier revision. The source documented here has changed since; until it is republished, confirm signatures against the live package.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

### `blast_presale::aftermath`

Permissionless Aftermath migration and LP-fee collection for configured presales.  A funded sale migrates into a fresh 50/50 Aftermath weighted pool wrapped in Aftermath's DAO-fee pool. Aftermath pays the DAO fee of every swap, deposit, and withdrawal as separate coins sent straight to the fee recipient address, so `migrate` names the sale's new vault as that recipient: the fee coins land owned by the vault object, and anyone may then receive them into the vault, where they are split like any collection. The LP coin, the whole pool liquidity, is sent to `0x0`, so the pool's liquidity is locked for good; the vault's position is the DAO-fee pool's `OwnerCap`, which could otherwise change the fee or redirect it, under its sealed position key with no removal path.  Aftermath creates a pool only from a `CreatePoolCapV2` minted by a freshly published LP coin, so the creator publishes one per sale and hands its capability to `finalize`, which finalizes the sale and returns the reservation bound to that sale's ID for `share`; only that sale's migration can consume it. `new` returns a `FinalizeTicket` beside the initializer, and only `finalize` here consumes it, so a creation transaction that finalizes through the core ends holding the ticket and fails: no Aftermath sale exists without its reservation.  Aftermath's registry rejects a second pool with the same coins, weights, flatness, and fees, but no sale token circulates before migration, so nobody can create the sale's pool first and the migration creates it with the module's fixed terms.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/aftermath.move

#### Types

```move
/// Sealed Aftermath migrator identity fixed before commitments open.
public struct Witness() has drop;

/// Sealed marker for the DAO-fee pool owner cap a presale vault holds as its position.
public struct Venue() has drop;

/// Hot potato `new` returns beside the sale's initializer, and only `finalize` consumes. It has no
/// abilities, so the transaction that starts a sale here must finalize it here, which binds the
/// reservation its migration needs. Its type parameters admit only the initializer of the same
/// sale token, the one `new` started, since `new` consumed that token's unique treasury cap.
public struct FinalizeTicket<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> {}

/// Reservation of one sale's Aftermath pool creation, returned by `finalize` and shared by
/// `share`: the `CreatePoolCapV2` of the fresh LP coin `Lp`, which only the migration of the sale
/// `presale_id` can consume.
public struct PoolCreation<phantom Lp, phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    presale_id: ID,
    create_pool_cap: pool::CreatePoolCapV2,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a presale that migrates to an Aftermath pool charging `dao_fee_bps` of every swap,
/// deposit, and withdrawal to the sale's vault. The fee is the sale's pool tier, recorded under
/// its token's type with no tick spacing; the pool's weights and base fee are this module's
/// constants. The sale is set like any other and finalized only through this module's
/// `finalize`, which consumes the ticket returned here and reserves its pool creation.
public fun new<Meme, Quote>(
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<Meme>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    venue_config: &mut venue_config::VenueConfig,
    dao_fee_bps: u16,
): (blast_presale::PresaleInitializer<Meme, Quote>, FinalizeTicket<Meme, Quote>)

/// Finalizes a sale `new` started, consuming the ticket `new` returned with it, and returns the
/// sale with the reservation binding `create_pool_cap`, which the fresh LP coin `Lp` minted, to
/// that sale's ID. The ticket's type parameters admit only the initializer of the same sale token,
/// which `new` started, so no other migrator's sale can take a reservation. The reservation has
/// only `key`, so the PTB that creates the sale must share it with `share`; a sale is never funded
/// in that PTB.
public fun finalize<Lp, Meme, Quote>(
    initializer: blast_presale::PresaleInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    ticket: FinalizeTicket<Meme, Quote>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    create_pool_cap: pool::CreatePoolCapV2,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (blast_presale::Presale<Meme, Quote>, blast_presale::PresaleCap, PoolCreation<Lp, Meme, Quote>)

/// Shares a reservation `finalize` returned, so anyone can migrate its sale once it is funded.
public fun share<Lp, Meme, Quote>(
    self: PoolCreation<Lp, Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
)

/// Anyone may migrate a funded presale into its reserved Aftermath pool, consuming the
/// reservation bound to it: it seeds a 50/50 pool with all of the sale's LP tokens and Quote,
/// wraps it in a DAO-fee pool paying the sale's new vault at the fee `new` recorded, shares that
/// pool, locks the pool's owner cap in the vault as its position, and sends the LP coin to `0x0`.
public fun migrate<Lp, Meme, Quote>(
    sale: &mut blast_presale::Presale<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    pool_creation: PoolCreation<Lp, Meme, Quote>,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    venue_config: &venue_config::VenueConfig,
    pool_registry: &mut pool_registry::PoolRegistry,
    dao_fee_version: &version::Version,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Anyone may receive the DAO fees Aftermath sent to an Aftermath vault's address, one
/// `Receiving` per fee coin, and split them as LP fees, paying Blast and each fee recipient and
/// accruing the holder Quote and paying holder Meme to the governed treasury. An empty collection
/// is valid. Another venue's vault aborts: its fees settle only through its own venue.
public fun collect_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    vault: &mut presale_vault::Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    meme_fees: vector<transfer::Receiving<Coin<Meme>>>,
    quote_fees: vector<transfer::Receiving<Coin<Quote>>>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Events

```move
/// `finalize` reserved the sale `presale_id`'s Aftermath pool creation for the LP coin `Lp` in the
/// shared `pool_creation_id`, holding the capability `create_pool_cap_id`; that sale's migration
/// consumes both.
public struct PoolCreationReserved<phantom Lp, phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    pool_creation_id: ID,
    create_pool_cap_id: ID,
}

/// A sale migrated into the Aftermath pool `pool_id`, which traders reach through the shared
/// DAO-fee pool `dao_fee_pool_id` paying its fees to the vault `vault_id`. The vault holds that
/// pool's owner cap `owner_cap_id` as its position, and the LP coin `lp_coin_id`, the whole pool
/// liquidity, is owned by `0x0`.
public struct DaoFeePoolCreated<phantom Lp, phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    pool_id: ID,
    dao_fee_pool_id: ID,
    owner_cap_id: ID,
    lp_coin_id: ID,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EPoolMismatch` | 0 | The Aftermath pool must hold every sale token and Quote unit the presale released. |
| `EDaoFeePoolMismatch` | 1 | The DAO-fee pool must charge this module's fee and pay the vault. |
| `EWrongPresale` | 2 | The pool creation is bound to a different presale. |
| `EInvalidDaoFee` | 3 | Aftermath DAO fee needs 1..=10,000 basis points. |
| `EWrongVault` | 4 | Only an Aftermath vault's fees are collected here. |

#### Constants

- `MAX_DAO_FEE_BPS: u16 = 10_000`: Aftermath's own bound on a DAO fee, the whole amount, which its DAO-fee pool creation asserts as `fee_bps <= 10_000`.
- `HALF_WEIGHT: u64 = 500_000_000_000_000_000`: Each coin's weight: half of Aftermath's `1e18` fixed-point one.
- `FLATNESS: u64 = 0`: Selects Aftermath's uncorrelated weighted-product curve.
- `BASE_SWAP_FEE: u64 = 100_000_000_000_000`: Aftermath's minimum base swap-in fee, 0.01% in its `1e18` unit; it rejects zero. This part compounds into the locked LP.
- `POOL_NAME: vector<u8> = b"Blast Presale Pool"`

### `blast_presale::blast_presale`

Standalone presales with capped commitments, proportional fills or a first-come hard cap, migration-gated claims, and full refunds when a sale does not migrate.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/blast_presale.move

#### Types

```move
/// Who may commit and the maximum Quote each wallet may commit.
///
/// `Open` gives every wallet the same cap and minimum. The minimum times the
/// participant bound must reach the raise, so filling every slot funds the sale
/// and dust commitments cannot lock real buyers out. `Allowlisted` commits one
/// cap per wallet in a positional Blake2b-256 Merkle tree, supporting equal,
/// tiered, or fully custom caps.
public enum EligibilityPolicy has copy, drop, store {
    Open {
        wallet_cap: u64,
        max_participants: u64,
        min_commitment: u64,
    },
    Allowlisted {
        root: vector<u8>,
        leaf_count: u64,
    },
}

/// Who may commit once an uncapped phase lifts wallet caps.
public enum UncappedAccess has copy, drop, store {
    /// Only wallets the sale's eligibility policy admits, without their caps.
    Eligible,
    /// Any wallet, bounded like an open policy: `min_commitment` over the slots held to it must
    /// reach the raise so dust cannot lock buyers out. Every slot counts under an open policy;
    /// under an allowlist only the slots beyond its leaves do, since allowlisted wallets may
    /// commit any positive amount.
    Anyone {
        max_participants: u64,
        min_commitment: u64,
    },
}

/// An optional closing phase, starting `starts_after_ms` into the commitment window,
/// that lifts wallet caps. Whether the sale then overflows or stops at its raise is the
/// sale's `HardCap`, not the phase's.
public struct UncappedPhase has copy, drop, store {
    starts_after_ms: u64,
    access: UncappedAccess,
}

/// From `starts_after_ms` into the commitment window, the sale takes Quote only up to its
/// raise, first come, first served: a commitment takes what is left and returns the excess at
/// once, and the sale stops accepting Quote when the raise is full. Before then it overflows,
/// filling every wallet at one common rate. With `closes_when_filled`, a sale whose raise is full
/// under its hard cap may settle at once instead of waiting for the window's end.
public struct HardCap has copy, drop, store {
    starts_after_ms: u64,
    closes_when_filled: bool,
}

/// The presale's one-way lifecycle.
public enum Lifecycle has copy, drop, store {
    Pending,
    Open,
    Funded,
    Migrated,
    Cancelled,
}

/// One creator's authority over one presale.
public struct PresaleCap has key, store {
    id: UID,
    presale_id: ID,
}

/// Linear vesting from the schedule's start, migration for a recipient share and the claim for a
/// participant: nothing before `cliff_ms`, then the vested amount steps up every `period_ms` until
/// all `periods` have elapsed.
public struct VestingTerms has copy, drop, store {
    cliff_ms: u64,
    period_ms: u64,
    periods: u64,
}

/// One recipient's share, in BPS, of the token supply, of the raise, or of every collected LP
/// fee. The creator takes LP fees as an ordinary fee recipient. A token or raise share may vest;
/// a fee share may not.
public struct RecipientShare has copy, drop, store {
    recipient: address,
    bps: bps::Bps,
    vesting: Option<VestingTerms>,
}

/// The exact token or Quote amount one recipient receives at migration, apportioned from its
/// `RecipientShare` when the presale is created, and the terms it vests under, if any.
public struct RecipientPayout has copy, drop, store {
    recipient: address,
    amount: u64,
    vesting: Option<VestingTerms>,
}

/// How every collected LP fee is split: each recipient's share, then the holder-reward share.
/// Only `fee_split` builds one, so wherever a split is held its rates total exactly 10,000 BPS and
/// every fee it apportions is assigned in full.
public struct FeeSplit has copy, drop, store {
    fee_recipients: vector<RecipientShare>,
    holder_rewards_bps: bps::Bps,
}

/// Dynamic-field name for one wallet's undelivered commitment.
public struct CommitmentKey(address) has copy, drop, store;

/// One wallet's Quote commitment and immutable cap.
public struct Commitment has copy, drop, store {
    quote: u64,
    wallet_cap: u64,
}

/// Hot potato from `new` to `finalize`, collecting the creator's settings. Only `finalize`
/// consumes it, so every sale is finalized in the transaction whose `new` checked the creation
/// policy and snapshotted Blast's rates. `finalize` validates the settings together; the supply,
/// token allocations, raise, windows, eligibility policy, and LP-fee split must all be set.
public struct PresaleInitializer<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> {
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<SaleToken>,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    protocol_fees: fee_policy::ProtocolFees,
    token_supply: u64,
    burnable: bool,
    token_allocation_bps: bps::Bps,
    liquidity_token_allocation_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipient_allocations: vector<RecipientShare>,
    participant_vesting: Option<VestingTerms>,
    raise_target: u64,
    raise_allocations: vector<RecipientShare>,
    duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_ms: u64,
    eligibility: Option<EligibilityPolicy>,
    uncapped: Option<UncappedPhase>,
    hard_cap: Option<HardCap>,
    fee_split: Option<FeeSplit>,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// One standalone presale and its complete custody until migration or refund.
///
/// The complete fixed or burn-only token supply is apportioned at creation.
/// Presale, LP, Blast, and additional recipient allocations stay escrowed until
/// a funded migration atomically releases them. Blast's rates are snapshotted
/// at creation, Blast's `FeeAdmin` may change them until the window starts, and its
/// fees are paid only on migration, or, when the sale names a Blast partner,
/// held from migration until `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner` pays the partner its cut of Blast's
/// raise fee. If the raise is missed, every commitment
/// is refunded. Anyone may migrate a funded sale until it is cancelled; once LP
/// is still unmigrated at its deadline, anyone may cancel it so every
/// commitment becomes refundable. Under participant vesting, each claim locks the
/// participant's tokens in its own schedule instead of paying them out.
public struct Presale<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    presale_cap_id: ID,
    lifecycle: Lifecycle,
    /// The commitment window's length: as created until the sale closes early, then the time it
    /// ran.
    duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_ms: u64,
    /// When commitments open, fixed by `share`; zero until then. The window's end, the LP
    /// deadline, and the uncapped and hard-cap starts are derived from it and the lengths above.
    start_ms: u64,
    raise_target: u64,
    eligibility: EligibilityPolicy,
    uncapped: Option<UncappedPhase>,
    hard_cap: Option<HardCap>,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    fee_split: FeeSplit,
    total_commitments: u64,
    /// The wallets holding an undelivered commitment: admitted by their first commitment and
    /// released by their claim, so the claim that empties the sale is the last one.
    participants: u64,
    quote: Balance<Quote>,
    token_allocation: u64,
    participant_vesting: Option<VestingTerms>,
    sale_tokens: Balance<SaleToken>,
    liquidity_tokens: Balance<SaleToken>,
    recipient_payouts: vector<RecipientPayout>,
    recipient_tokens: Balance<SaleToken>,
    raise_payouts: vector<RecipientPayout>,
    protocol_fees: fee_policy::ProtocolFees,
    protocol_quote: u64,
    protocol_tokens: Balance<SaleToken>,
    /// The Blast partner named at creation, paid its cut of Blast's raise fee. It never changes
    /// once the sale is shared.
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
    /// Blast's raise fee, held from a partnered sale's migration until
    /// `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner` splits it.
    unpaid_protocol_quote: Option<Balance<Quote>>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Creates one equal-cap policy with a bounded number of distinct wallets, each
/// of which must commit at least `min_commitment` in total.
public fun open_eligibility(
    wallet_cap: u64,
    max_participants: u64,
    min_commitment: u64,
): EligibilityPolicy

/// Creates one allowlist policy whose leaves are `(index, wallet, wallet_cap)`.
public fun allowlisted_eligibility(root: vector<u8>, leaf_count: u64): EligibilityPolicy

/// Lifts wallet caps for eligible wallets `start_delay_ms` into the window.
public fun uncapped_for_eligible(start_delay_ms: u64): UncappedPhase

/// Opens the sale to any wallet without caps `start_delay_ms` into the window, admitting
/// at most `max_participants` wallets in total, each committing at least `min_commitment`.
public fun uncapped_for_anyone(
    start_delay_ms: u64,
    max_participants: u64,
    min_commitment: u64,
): UncappedPhase

/// One recipient's share in BPS. Presale creation validates each list of shares under that
/// list's own rules and error.
public fun recipient_share(recipient: address, bps: bps::Bps): RecipientShare

/// One recipient's token or raise share in BPS, locked at migration in an irrevocable linear
/// schedule under `vesting` instead of paid out.
public fun vested_recipient_share(
    recipient: address,
    bps: bps::Bps,
    vesting: VestingTerms,
): RecipientShare

/// Linear vesting terms. The steps and cliff must fit in `MAX_VESTING_DURATION_MS`, so migration and
/// claims can always create the schedule. Product limits on the duration belong to creation tooling.
public fun vesting_terms(
    vesting_cliff_delay_ms: u64,
    vesting_period_duration_ms: u64,
    periods: u64,
): VestingTerms

/// The LP-fee split a sale and its vault pay collected fees under: at most `MAX_FEE_RECIPIENTS`
/// distinct unvested recipients whose shares total exactly 10,000 BPS with the holder-reward
/// share. The creator takes its LP fees as one of the recipients.
public fun fee_split(fee_recipients: vector<RecipientShare>, holder_rewards_bps: bps::Bps): FeeSplit

/// Starts a presale of `SaleToken` raising `Quote` for the migrator that constructs
/// `MigrationWitness`, and snapshots Blast's rates. The venue's pool terms, such as a CLMM tier,
/// belong to the migrator, which records any it needs before calling this.
///
/// A migrator in this or any other package starts its sales here with its own `MigrationWitness`,
/// which only its defining module can construct. The `CreationPolicy` must allow that witness, so
/// Blast decides which migrators may open sales; the sale then releases its liquidity only to
/// `migrate` called with the same witness.
public fun new<SaleToken, Quote, MigrationWitness: drop>(
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<SaleToken>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: MigrationWitness,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
): PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>

/// Sets the complete supply `finalize` mints, and whether it then becomes burn-only rather than
/// fixed.
public fun set_supply<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    token_supply: u64,
    burnable: bool,
)

/// Splits the supply in BPS between the buyers, the LP, and each recipient. With Blast's token
/// rate the shares must total exactly 10,000 BPS.
public fun set_token_allocations<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    token_allocation_bps: bps::Bps,
    liquidity_token_allocation_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipient_allocations: vector<RecipientShare>,
)

/// Locks each participant's claimed tokens in its own schedule under `vesting`, starting at its
/// claim, instead of paying them out. Without it, claims pay tokens out at once.
public fun set_participant_vesting<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    vesting: VestingTerms,
)

/// Sets the Quote the sale raises and each recipient's share of it, paid at migration. The LP
/// keeps what Blast's and the recipients' shares leave.
public fun set_raise<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    raise_target: u64,
    raise_allocations: vector<RecipientShare>,
)

/// Sets how long commitments stay open from the start, and how long after the window anyone may
/// migrate a funded sale before anyone may cancel it: at least seven days.
public fun set_windows<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    commitment_duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_duration_ms: u64,
)

/// Sets who may commit and each wallet's cap.
public fun set_eligibility<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    eligibility: EligibilityPolicy,
)

/// Adds a closing phase that lifts wallet caps. Without one, caps hold for the whole window.
public fun set_uncapped_phase<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    uncapped: UncappedPhase,
)

/// Hard-caps the sale at its raise from `start_delay_ms` into the window: zero for the whole
/// window, or the uncapped phase's offset to keep an overflowing capped phase before it. With
/// `closes_when_filled`, anyone may settle the sale once its raise is full under the hard cap;
/// without it, a full sale waits for the window's end. Without a hard cap, the sale overflows
/// for the whole window and always runs to its end.
public fun set_hard_cap<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    start_delay_ms: u64,
    closes_when_filled: bool,
)

/// Sets how the sale's vault splits every collected LP fee.
public fun set_fee_split<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_split: FeeSplit,
)

/// Names the sale's Blast partner, one the `CreationPolicy` lets new presales name; from
/// `finalize` on it is the sale's partner for good. The partner earns its cut of Blast's raise
/// fee, which migration holds until `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner` pays it, and its vault inherits
/// the partner, which then earns its cut of Blast's LP fees (ADR 0107). It never shares Blast's
/// token fee.
public fun set_partner<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// The witness type of the migrator that started the sale, so a migrator finalizing an
/// initializer it is handed can confirm the sale is its own.
public fun migration_witness<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
): TypeName

/// Requires a confirmed unregulated sale currency and checks every setting, then mints and
/// apportions the complete token supply and
/// irreversibly makes it fixed or burn-only before returning the presale for `share`.
public fun finalize<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    currency: &mut Currency<SaleToken>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Presale<SaleToken, Quote>, PresaleCap)

/// Shares a newly created presale and fixes its windows from `commitment_starts_at_ms`, or from now once that
/// has passed, so a sale can be created ahead of its start. Commitments open at the start; until
/// then Blast's `FeeAdmin` may change the sale's Blast rates.
public fun share<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    commitment_starts_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Replaces this sale's snapshot of Blast's rates before its window starts, while nobody can have
/// committed: in its creation transaction before `share`, or once shared until its start. A
/// changed token rate reapportions Blast's tokens against the buyers' sale allocation and a
/// changed raise rate its Quote against the LP's, each rounded down; an unchanged rate keeps its
/// amount, and every recipient keeps its amount.
public fun set_protocol_fees<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    raise_bps: bps::Bps,
    token_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Locks the supplied `Coin<Quote>` in this presale under an equal-cap, open
/// eligibility policy and returns whatever a hard-capped uncapped phase could not
/// accept (a zero coin otherwise).
public fun commit_open<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Locks Quote from an allowlisted wallet after verifying its Merkle-committed cap,
/// returning whatever a hard cap could not accept.
public fun commit_allowlisted<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    index: u64,
    wallet_cap: u64,
    proof: vector<vector<u8>>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Locks Quote from any wallet once an uncapped phase open to anyone has started,
/// returning whatever a hard cap could not accept.
public fun commit_uncapped<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Fixes the fill after the commitment window, or as soon as the raise is full under a hard cap
/// that closes the sale when filled; closing early ends the window now, so the LP deadline counts
/// from now. Underfunded sales become fully refundable. Anyone may settle.
public fun settle<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels a funded presale still unmigrated at its LP deadline, preserving all
/// Quote for refunds. Anyone may cancel.
public fun cancel_unlaunched<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Delivers one participant's pro-rata tokens and overflow Quote after migration,
/// or its full Quote after cancellation. Under participant vesting, the tokens are
/// locked in a shared irrevocable linear schedule starting at this claim instead of
/// paid out; the Quote refund is always paid at once. Anyone may relay; the final
/// claim receives the bounded integer-rounding remainder.
public fun claim<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    participant: address,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays Blast and the raise recipients their shares and releases every token
/// recipient's tokens at once, locking each vesting share in its own shared irrevocable
/// schedule starting now, then releases the rest of the raise and the
/// LP-token allocation only to the configured migrator, the holder of the witness the sale was
/// created with. A sale naming a Blast partner holds Blast's fees instead, for
/// `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner`.
/// Anyone may call that migrator at any time until the sale is cancelled; its pool creation
/// remains atomic with this state transition.
public fun migrate<SaleToken, Quote, MigrationWitness: drop>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    _: MigrationWitness,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Balance<SaleToken>, Balance<Quote>)

/// Pays a migrated sale's Blast partner its cut of Blast's raise fee, rounded down so Blast keeps
/// the remainder, and pays Blast the rest of it and its token fee at the `FeePolicy`'s current
/// destination. The cut is the partner's `blast_partners` rate in force now. Anyone may call it
/// once after migration: both recipients are fixed.
public fun pay_protocol_fees_with_partner<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Destroys the creator capability after cancellation. All minted SaleToken
/// allocations remain permanently locked in the cancelled presale.
public fun destroy_cap<SaleToken, Quote>(self: &Presale<SaleToken, Quote>, cap: PresaleCap)
```

#### Events

```move
/// A presale was created with fully funded token allocations.
public struct PresaleCreated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    presale_cap_id: ID,
    treasury_cap_id: ID,
    token_supply: u64,
    token_allocation_bps: u64,
    participant_vesting: Option<VestingTerms>,
    liquidity_token_allocation_bps: u64,
    recipients: vector<address>,
    recipient_bps: vector<u64>,
    recipient_vesting: vector<Option<VestingTerms>>,
    burnable: bool,
    raise_target: u64,
    raise_recipients: vector<address>,
    raise_recipient_bps: vector<u64>,
    raise_recipient_vesting: vector<Option<VestingTerms>>,
    duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_ms: u64,
    eligibility: EligibilityPolicy,
    uncapped: Option<UncappedPhase>,
    hard_cap: Option<HardCap>,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    fee_recipients: vector<address>,
    fee_recipient_bps: vector<u64>,
    holder_rewards_bps: u64,
    /// Blast's rates, snapshotted for this sale.
    protocol_raise_bps: u64,
    protocol_token_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
    /// Blast's shares of the raise and of the supply, paid on migration.
    protocol_quote: u64,
    protocol_tokens: u64,
}

/// A presale was shared with these commitment and liquidity windows and its Blast partner, if
/// any. Commitments open at `start_ms`, which may be later than the share. A sale whose hard cap
/// closes it when filled may end earlier; `PresaleFunded` records when it did.
public struct PresaleOpened<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    start_ms: u64,
    end_ms: u64,
    liquidity_deadline_ms: u64,
    uncapped_from_ms: u64,
    hard_cap_from_ms: Option<u64>,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// Before the window started, Blast's `FeeAdmin` replaced this sale's Blast rates, moving Blast's tokens
/// to or from the sale allocation and its Quote to or from the LP's.
public struct ProtocolFeesChanged<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    protocol_raise_bps: u64,
    protocol_token_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
    /// Blast's shares of the raise and of the supply, paid on migration.
    protocol_quote: u64,
    protocol_tokens: u64,
    /// The tokens buyers now share pro rata.
    token_allocation: u64,
}

/// Quote joined a presale from the transaction sender.
public struct Committed<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    quote: u64,
    wallet_commitment: u64,
    total_commitments: u64,
    participants: u64,
}

/// A funded presale closed at `end_ms` with these fixed claim totals; anyone may cancel it once
/// it is still unmigrated at `liquidity_deadline_ms`. Both are earlier than `PresaleOpened`'s
/// when the sale closed early.
public struct PresaleFunded<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    total_commitments: u64,
    accepted_quote: u64,
    refundable_quote: u64,
    token_allocation: u64,
    end_ms: u64,
    liquidity_deadline_ms: u64,
}

/// A presale became fully refundable without releasing Quote.
public struct PresaleCancelled<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    total_commitments: u64,
    refundable_quote: u64,
}

/// The raise left after Blast's and the recipients' shares, and the LP-token allocation,
/// entered the configured migrator.
public struct PresaleMigrated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    liquidity_quote: u64,
    liquidity_tokens: u64,
    recipient_tokens: u64,
}

/// Blast received `quote` of its raise fee and its `tokens` at `destination`, after the sale's
/// Blast partner took `partner_quote` of the raise fee, which `PartnerPaid` also records.
public struct ProtocolFeesPaid<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    destination: address,
    quote: u64,
    tokens: u64,
    partner_quote: u64,
}

/// One configured recipient received its share of the raise, or the vesting schedule
/// `vesting_id` that holds it.
public struct RaiseAllocated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    quote: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// One configured recipient received its immutable token allocation, or the vesting schedule
/// `vesting_id` that holds it.
public struct RecipientAllocated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    tokens: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// `participant` received its token allocation, or the vesting schedule `vesting_id` that holds
/// it, and its Quote refund, leaving `remaining_participants` wallets still to claim.
public struct Claimed<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    participant: address,
    wallet_commitment: u64,
    tokens: u64,
    quote_refund: u64,
    remaining_participants: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EInvalidAssetPair` | 0 | The sale token and Quote type must differ. |
| `EInvalidRaiseTarget` | 1 | The raise target must be positive. |
| `EInvalidTokenAllocation` | 2 | The supply must be positive, and token allocations unique, positive, bounded, totalling exactly 10,000 BPS with Blast's share, and apportioning to positive amounts. |
| `EInvalidWindow` | 3 | The commitment window must be positive, the liquidity window at least seven days, and both must end within u64 milliseconds. |
| `EInvalidEligibilityPolicy` | 4 | The eligibility policy has an invalid cap, participant bound, root, or leaf count. |
| `EInvalidLifecycle` | 5 | The presale is not in the lifecycle required by this operation. |
| `EPresaleEnded` | 6 | The presale commitment window has ended. |
| `EPresaleNotEnded` | 7 | The presale commitment window has not ended, and the sale cannot close early: its raise is not full under a hard cap that closes it when filled. |
| `EZeroCommitment` | 8 | A presale commitment must be positive. |
| `EWalletCapExceeded` | 9 | The wallet commitment exceeds its eligibility cap. |
| `EParticipantCapacityReached` | 10 | The presale already contains its maximum number of participants. |
| `EInvalidEligibilityProof` | 11 | The submitted wallet, cap, index, or proof does not match the allowlist. |
| `EWrongEligibilityPolicy` | 12 | The commit function does not match the presale eligibility policy. |
| `ETotalCommitmentOverflow` | 13 | Adding the commitment would overflow the presale total. |
| `ENoCommitment` | 14 | The wallet has no undelivered presale commitment. |
| `EWrongPresaleCap` | 15 | The creator capability belongs to a different presale. |
| `ELiquidityDeadlineNotReached` | 16 | The deadline to cancel an unlaunched funded presale has not arrived. |
| `EInitialSupplyNotZero` | 17 | The supplied SaleToken TreasuryCap must have zero total supply. |
| `EInvalidFeeSplit` | 18 | Fee recipients must be unique, positive, unvested, bounded, and total 10,000 BPS with the holder-reward share. |
| `EWrongMigrationWitness` | 19 | The migrator does not match the venue fixed at presale creation. |
| `EBelowMinimumCommitment` | 20 | The wallet's total commitment is below the sale's minimum commitment. |
| `EUnreachableRaise` | 21 | The minimum commitment times the slots held to it, the participant bound of an open policy or the open-to-anyone phase slots beyond any allowlist, must reach the raise target. |
| `EUnseedablePrice` | 22 | The raise and LP-token allocation give a seed price the venues cannot pool. |
| `EInvalidUncappedPhase` | 23 | An uncapped phase must start inside the window, and an open-to-anyone phase needs a positive minimum and a participant bound between the policy's and 65,536. |
| `EUncappedPhaseNotOpen` | 24 | The presale has no uncapped phase open to any wallet, or it has not started. |
| `EPresaleFilled` | 25 | The presale has already reached its raise under its hard cap. |
| `EInvalidRaiseAllocation` | 26 | Raise allocations must be unique, positive, bounded, leave the LP a share after Blast's, and apportion to positive amounts. |
| `EInvalidVestingTerms` | 27 | Vesting needs a positive period and period count, a cliff within its duration, and a duration of at most 2^63 milliseconds. |
| `EPresaleNotStarted` | 28 | The presale commitment window has not started. |
| `EPresaleStarted` | 29 | A presale's Blast rates can change only before its commitment window starts. |
| `EProtocolFeesUnchanged` | 30 | A presale fee update must change its stored rates. |
| `EWrongPartner` | 31 | The partner is not the one this presale named at creation. |
| `ENoPartnerPayout` | 32 | The presale holds no partner payout: it has not migrated, or its partner was already paid. |
| `EInvalidHardCap` | 33 | A hard cap must start inside the commitment window. |
| `EMissingSetting` | 34 | A presale needs its eligibility policy and LP-fee split set before it is finalized. |
| `ESaleTokenNotUnregulated` | 35 | The sale currency must be confirmed unregulated; regulated and unknown legacy currencies are not allowed. |

#### Constants

- `MAX_PARTICIPANTS: u64 = 65_536`: Technical bound on the dynamic commitment records one presale may hold.
- `MAX_RECIPIENTS: u64 = 64`: Bounds the token and raise recipient lists, both paid in the one migration transaction.
- `MAX_FEE_RECIPIENTS: u64 = 16`: Bounds the transfers one fee collection makes.
- `MIN_LIQUIDITY_WINDOW_DURATION_MS: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000`: The shortest LP-migration window. Migration is permissionless, so a funded sale reaches its refund exit only after a week in which nobody migrated it, and a sale that nobody settled by its end cannot be settled and cancelled in one transaction inside that week.
- `MAX_VESTING_DURATION_MS: u64 = 1 << 63`: A technical bound on a vesting schedule's duration: from any clock below 2^63 ms, about 292 million years, the schedule's end still fits in u64, so migration cannot overflow creating it.

### `blast_presale::blast_presale_domain`

Blast presale's administration roles in the shared Blast ACL.  A role is a type. An `AdminCap` holding `Role` signs in to `AdminWitness<Role>`, and a function's witness parameter names the one role it accepts, so no role authorizes another's actions and a role from any other package cannot reach these operations.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/blast_presale_domain.move

#### Types

```move
/// Authorizes compatible package upgrades and their atomic operational-version cutover.
public struct UpgradeAdmin {}

/// Sets the address every protocol fee is paid to.
public struct TreasuryAdmin {}

/// Sets Blast's rates for new sales, one sale before its start, and one migrated sale's vault, and
/// the partners new sales may name.
public struct FeeAdmin {}

/// Admits or removes the Quotes new sales and vaults may use.
public struct ListingAdmin {}

/// Admits or removes the migrators that may create sales and vaults.
public struct AdapterAdmin {}

/// Publishes holder-reward rounds and settles capped gas reserves.
public struct RewardsAdmin {}
```

### `blast_presale::blast_presale_package`

Canonical package provenance, publication bootstrap, and operational generation.  The one-time witness seeds the generation and claims the Publisher. Both stay in owned bootstrap custody until package administration seals the native capabilities.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/blast_presale_package.move

#### Types

```move
/// One-time witness: it seeds the package generation and claims this package's Publisher.
public struct BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE() has drop;

/// Publication-only custody; it cannot supply the PackageVersion required by presale activity.
public struct Bootstrap has key {
    id: UID,
    publisher: Publisher,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
}

/// Singleton operational package generation.
public struct PackageVersion has key {
    id: UID,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
}
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: Current package generation accepted by every protected mutation.
- `NEXT_PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 2`: The generation this bytecode hands over to in a governed upgrade.

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a presale irrevocably configured to migrate to a Bluefin pool at this tier. Every sale
/// token has one sale, so the tier is recorded under its type.
public fun new<Meme, Quote>(
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<Meme>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    currency: &Currency<Meme>,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    venue_config: &mut venue_config::VenueConfig,
    tick_spacing: u32,
    pool_fee_rate: u64,
): blast_presale::PresaleInitializer<Meme, Quote>

/// Anyone may atomically migrate a funded presale into its configured Bluefin pool.
public fun migrate<Meme, Quote>(
    sale: &mut blast_presale::Presale<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    venue_config: &venue_config::VenueConfig,
    currency: &Currency<Meme>,
    quote_currency: &Currency<Quote>,
    bluefin_config: &mut config::GlobalConfig,
    creation_fee: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Seals the caller's own Bluefin position in `pool`, whose first coin must be Meme, in a new
/// shared vault splitting its LP fees by `fee_split`, after Blast's current rates. The liquidity is
/// locked for good. Blast must allow Quote and this migrator, as for a presale,
/// and accept the partner, if one is named.
public fun new_vault<Meme, Quote>(
    position: position::Position,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_split: blast_presale::FeeSplit,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    pool: &pool::Pool<Meme, Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Anyone may collect LP fees, paying Blast and each fee recipient and accruing the
/// holder Quote and paying holder Meme to the governed treasury.
public fun collect_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    vault: &mut presale_vault::Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    bluefin_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<Meme, Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EPositionPoolMismatch` | 0 | Pool must be the one holding the position. |
| `EInvalidTier` | 1 | Bluefin tier needs tick spacing 1..=400 and fee rate 1..=20,000. |
| `ESymbolTooLong` | 2 | The Meme symbol must be at most 32 bytes for Bluefin migration. |

#### Constants

- `MAX_TICK_SPACING: u32 = 400`
- `MAX_POOL_FEE_RATE: u64 = 20_000`
- `MAX_MEME_SYMBOL_LENGTH: u64 = 32`: Bluefin stores the pool name, built from this symbol, twice in every `Position`; the bound keeps a migrated position inside Sui's object size limit (ADR 0088).

/// Starts a presale that migrates to a Cetus pool at `tick_spacing`, whose fee rate Cetus derives
/// from it, and reserves the pair's pool creation at that tier before the supply is minted. Every

### `blast_presale::creation_policy`

Blast's allowlists for new presales and new vaults without a presale: the Quote coins a sale may raise or a vault may hold, the migrators, in this package or another, that may create a sale or, for this package's venues, such a vault, and the Blast partners a sale may name.  A presale or vault is checked once, when it is created. Later changes apply only to later sales, so a delisting never strands a live sale's commitments, blocks its migration, or stops paying its partner.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/creation_policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding the Quote types and migration witnesses new presales may use.
public struct CreationPolicy has key {
    id: UID,
    allowed_quotes: VecSet<TypeName>,
    allowed_migration_witnesses: VecSet<TypeName>,
}

/// Dynamic-field key of a Blast partner new presales may name. Its value is the time the partner
/// stops being accepted: `u64::MAX` until Blast removes it.
public struct PartnerKey(ID) has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Allows or disallows `Quote` for presales and vaults without a presale created afterward;
/// existing ones keep it.
public fun set_quote_allowed<Quote>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::ListingAdmin>,
    allowed: bool,
)

/// Allows or disallows the migrator identified by `MigrationWitness` to create presales, and its
/// venue vaults without a presale, afterward; existing sales still migrate through it.
///
/// `presale::new` and `presale::migrate` are public, so whoever can construct an allowed witness
/// can open sales and release their liquidity. Allow only a struct whose defining module is the
/// reviewed migrator and keeps its constructor private. A primitive, a vector, or a framework type,
/// any of which a caller can construct, is rejected.
public fun set_migration_witness_allowed<MigrationWitness: drop>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::AdapterAdmin>,
    allowed: bool,
)

/// Lets new presales name `partner`, at once. Adding a partner whose removal is pending cancels
/// the removal; adding a removed partner accepts it again.
public fun add_partner(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
)

/// Stops new presales naming `partner` after the notice Blast gives for every change to a
/// partner, `blast_partners::delay_ms()`. Sales that already name it keep paying it.
public fun remove_partner(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)
```

#### Events

```move
/// Presales created afterward may (`allowed`) or may not raise `quote`.
public struct QuoteSet has copy, drop {
    quote: TypeName,
    allowed: bool,
}

/// The migrator identified by `migration_witness` may (`allowed`) or may not create presales
/// afterward.
public struct MigrationWitnessSet has copy, drop {
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    allowed: bool,
}

/// Presales created from now on may name the partner `partner_id`.
public struct PartnerAdded has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
}

/// Presales created before `accepted_until_ms` may still name the partner `partner_id`; later ones
/// may not.
public struct PartnerRemoved has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
    accepted_until_ms: u64,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EAllowanceUnchanged` | 0 | An allowlist update must change whether the type or partner is allowed. |
| `EQuoteNotAllowed` | 1 | This Quote type is not allowed for new presales. |
| `EMigrationWitnessNotAllowed` | 2 | This migration witness is not allowed for new presales. |
| `EInvalidMigrationWitness` | 3 | A migration witness must be a non-framework struct, never a primitive, vector, or framework type any caller can construct. |
| `EPartnerNotAccepted` | 4 | New presales may not name this partner. |

### `blast_presale::fee_policy`

Blast's fees on presales: a share of every successful raise, of every token supply, and of every collected LP fee.  Each presale snapshots the rates when it is created. Until the sale's window starts, the `FeeAdmin` may change that sale's rates, so its economics are fixed before commitments open; after migration it may change the sale's LP-fee rates on its vault. Every payout reads the current destination.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/fee_policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding the rates new presales snapshot and the address paid Blast's fees.
public struct FeePolicy has key {
    id: UID,
    destination: address,
    fees: ProtocolFees,
}

/// Blast's rates, in BPS: of the accepted raise, of the token supply, and of each collected
/// LP-fee asset.
public struct ProtocolFees has copy, drop, store {
    raise_bps: bps::Bps,
    token_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Sets the rates presales created afterward snapshot; existing presales keep theirs.
public fun set_fees(
    self: &mut FeePolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    raise_bps: bps::Bps,
    token_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
)

/// Redirects every later protocol payout, including those of existing presales.
public fun set_destination(
    self: &mut FeePolicy,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::TreasuryAdmin>,
    destination: address,
)
```

#### Events

```move
/// New presales snapshot these rates.
public struct FeesChanged has copy, drop {
    raise_bps: u64,
    token_bps: u64,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
}

/// Every later protocol payout goes to `destination`.
public struct DestinationChanged has copy, drop {
    destination: address,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EInvalidFees` | 0 | Blast's raise share must be below 10,000 BPS and its token share at most 9,998. |
| `EFeesUnchanged` | 1 | A fee update must change the stored rates. |
| `EInvalidDestination` | 2 | The protocol destination must be a new nonzero address. |

#### Constants

- `MAX_TOKEN_BPS: u64 = 9_998`: The sale and LP allocations each keep at least one BPS of the supply.

### `blast_presale::holder_rewards`

Merkle rounds Blast's rewards administrator funds from a migrated presale vault's holder-reward fee share.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/holder_rewards.move

#### Types

```move
/// A holder round with optional, independent one-shot gas custody.
/// Claims do not touch its gas reserve.
public struct Round<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    vault_id: ID,
    number: u64,
    claim_deadline_ms: u64,
    root: vector<u8>,
    leaf_count: u64,
    claimed_bitmap: vector<u256>,
    meme: Balance<Meme>,
    quote: Balance<Quote>,
    treasury: address,
    gas_reserve: Option<Balance<Quote>>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Atomically funds holder leaves and separate gas custody under the governed
/// treasury at publication. A zero reserve disables reimbursement for this round.
/// The signed expected treasury must still match the governed destination.
/// USD eligibility and gas attribution remain off chain.
public fun publish_round<Meme, Quote>(
    vault: &mut presale_vault::Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::RewardsAdmin>,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    expected_treasury: address,
    number: u64,
    start_checkpoint: u64,
    end_checkpoint: u64,
    root: vector<u8>,
    manifest_digest: vector<u8>,
    leaf_count: u64,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    gas_reserve_amount: u64,
    claim_deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays only the committed holder balances; anyone may relay an unchanged proof.
public fun claim<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Round<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    index: u64,
    beneficiary: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    proof: vector<vector<u8>>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// RewardsAdmin settles a measured, capped reimbursement once. The committed
/// treasury receives it; all unused reserve immediately returns to this vault.
public fun settle_gas_reserve<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Round<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::RewardsAdmin>,
    vault: &mut presale_vault::Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    reimbursement_amount: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Anyone can close at the deadline, returning all unclaimed holder funds and
/// any unsettled reserve. Missing settlement authority cannot strand custody.
public fun close_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: Round<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    vault: &mut presale_vault::Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EWrongRound` | 0 | Round number must match the vault's next round. |
| `EInvalidInterval` | 1 | Checkpoint interval must be nonempty and must not overlap a previous round. |
| `EInvalidCommitment` | 2 | Root and manifest digest must contain 32 bytes. |
| `EInvalidLeafCount` | 3 | Round must contain between 1 and 65,536 leaves. |
| `EEmptyBudget` | 4 | A round must reserve a positive amount of at least one asset. |
| `EInvalidIndex` | 5 | Claim index must be less than the committed leaf count. |
| `EAlreadyClaimed` | 6 | This allocation has already been paid. |
| `EInvalidBeneficiary` | 7 | Beneficiary must not be the zero address. |
| `EInvalidProof` | 8 | Proof must match the committed beneficiary and amounts. |
| `EInvalidClaimDeadline` | 9 | The claim deadline must be in the future. |
| `EWrongVault` | 10 | The round belongs to a different presale vault. |
| `EClaimsStillOpen` | 11 | The round's claim deadline has not passed. |
| `EEmptyClaim` | 12 | A reward claim must pay a positive amount of at least one asset. |
| `EInsufficientBudget` | 13 | Holder funding and gas reserve must fit the vault's available balances. |
| `EReserveSettled` | 14 | Gas reimbursement is disabled or its reserve has already been settled. |
| `EOverReserve` | 15 | Reimbursement must not exceed the bound gas reserve. |
| `ETreasuryChanged` | 16 | The governed treasury must match the publication commitment. |

#### Constants

- `MAX_REWARD_LEAVES: u64 = 65_536`

### `blast_presale::presale_vault`

Custody for one LP position, migrated from a presale or provided directly, its residuals, and its holder-reward fee share.  A venue whose pool pays its fees as coins sent to an address, rather than into a position, builds the vault before its position exists and names the vault's own ID as the recipient; the vault then receives those coins with Sui's transfer-to-object receiving and splits them like any collection.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/presale_vault.move

#### Types

```move
/// Sealed field name binding one venue position type to a vault.
public struct PositionKey<phantom Venue>() has copy, drop, store;

/// Shared custody for one LP position and its immutable fee split: a presale's, after migration, or
/// an owner's own position locked here directly, with zero presale and creator-capability IDs.
///
/// Each collection first takes Blast's LP fees of each asset at the vault's
/// rates, snapshotted at creation and changeable only by Blast's `FeeAdmin`, then
/// pays every fee recipient its share of the rest at once; the holder-reward
/// Quote share accrues here until Blast's rewards administrator funds a round.
/// Its holder Meme remainder is paid to the current governed fee destination.
/// Blast's LP fees go to the protocol destination at once, unless the sale named
/// a partner: then they wait here for `pay_protocol_lp_fees_with_partner`.
public struct Vault<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    presale_id: ID,
    presale_cap_id: ID,
    pool_id: ID,
    fee_split: blast_presale::FeeSplit,
    protocol_fees: fee_policy::ProtocolFees,
    /// The Blast partner the sale named, paid its cut of Blast's LP fees. It never changes.
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
    unpaid_protocol_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    unpaid_protocol_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    migration_meme_residual: Balance<Meme>,
    migration_quote_residual: Balance<Quote>,
    holder_rewards_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    holder_rewards_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    next_round: u64,
    last_checkpoint: Option<u64>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Claims the pool's one-time migration residuals with the creator capability.
public fun claim_migration_residuals<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    cap: &blast_presale::PresaleCap,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Sets Blast's share of each asset in this vault's later LP-fee collections. Fees still in the
/// pool are split at the new rates when collected; the creator's split of the rest is unchanged.
public fun set_protocol_lp_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_presale_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
)

/// Pays the Blast LP fees this vault holds for its partner: the partner its cut of each asset in
/// force now, rounded down, then the fee policy's current destination the rest. Anyone may call
/// it, since both payees are fixed. Holding nothing is valid, moves nothing, and emits nothing,
/// so it can follow any collection.
public fun pay_protocol_lp_fees_with_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Vault<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Events

```move

    /// Zero for a vault created without a presale.
    presale_id: ID,

    gross_meme: u64,
    gross_quote: u64,
    /// Where Blast's LP fees were paid, or none when the vault holds them for its partner.
    protocol_destination: Option<address>,
    protocol_meme: u64,
    protocol_quote: u64,
    /// Aligned by index with the immutable recipients in `VaultCreated`.
    fee_recipient_meme: vector<u64>,
    fee_recipient_quote: vector<u64>,
    holder_rewards_meme: u64,

    vault_id: ID,
    meme: u64,
    quote: u64,
}

/// A partnered vault paid the Blast LP fees it held: `partner_meme` and `partner_quote` to the
/// partner, and the rest, `protocol_meme` and `protocol_quote`, to `protocol_destination`.
public struct ProtocolLpFeesPaid<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    protocol_destination: address,
    protocol_meme: u64,
    protocol_quote: u64,
    partner_meme: u64,
    partner_quote: u64,
}

/// Every later collection from `vault_id` pays Blast at these rates.

    vault_id: ID,
    protocol_lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
}

/// The holder Meme allocation in `FeesCollected` was paid rather than accrued.
public struct HolderMemePaid<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    treasury: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    unallocated_meme_remaining: u64,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ENoMigrationResiduals` | 0 | No migration residuals are available to claim. |
| `EZeroLiquidity` | 1 | The vault's position must hold liquidity. |
| `EWrongPresaleCap` | 2 | The creator capability belongs to a different presale vault. |
| `EProtocolLpFeesUnchanged` | 3 | An LP-fee update must change the vault's Blast rates. |
| `EWrongPartner` | 4 | The partner is not the one this vault's presale named at creation. |

## API reference: `blast_fun` (Launchpad)

Not yet published on mainnet. Its interface may change before publication.

Events: every payload is emitted inside `blast_fun::blast_events::Event<T>`; filter on that type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EInvalidBps` | A basis-points value is above 10,000. |
| 1 | `EInvalidTradeFeeBps` | A trade fee is above the launch configuration's ceiling. |
| 2 | `EDecimalsNotAllowed` | The Meme decimals are not admitted for new launches. |
| 3 | `EMigrationWitnessNotAllowed` | The migration adapter is not admitted for new launches. |
| 4 | `EInvalidMigrationWitnessType` | A framework type cannot be a migration witness. |
| 5 | `EInvalidProtocolAllocation` | Blast's allocation leaves no room for the curve or pool. |
| 6 | `EInvalidDestination` | A recipient address is zero. |
| 7 | `EInvalidShares` | The shares do not sum to 10,000, or the curve or pool Meme share is zero. |
| 8 | `ERecipientCapacityReached` | A split has more than sixteen recipients. |
| 9 | `EInvalidSellBurnBps` | The sell-burn rate is above its ceiling. |
| 10 | `EInvalidInitialMemeSupply` | The ticket's supply is not the canonical one billion tokens. |
| 11 | `EInvalidMemeQuotePair` | Meme and Quote are the same type. |
| 12 | `EMemeSymbolTooLong` | The Meme symbol is longer than 32 bytes. |
| 13 | `EInvalidOpeningRound` | The opening round is neither zero nor within its bounds. |
| 14 | `EInvalidGraduationTarget` | The pool's Quote share of the graduation target rounds to zero. |
| 15 | `EInvalidLaunchLifecycle` | The launch is not in the state this operation needs. |
| 16 | `ESlippageExceeded` | The output is below the caller's minimum. |
| 17 | `EZeroTradeOutput` | The trade's net output is zero. |
| 18 | `EOpeningRoundEnded` | The opening round has ended. |
| 19 | `EOpeningRoundNotEnded` | The opening round has not ended, or the launch is not shared yet. |
| 20 | `ENothingAccrued` | There are no fees to claim. |
| 21 | `EInvalidMigrationWitness` | The witness is not the launch's migration adapter. |
| 22 | `ECreatorCapNotLive` | The creator cap is not the one the launch honors. |
| 23 | `EUnchanged` | A setter was called with the value already in place. |
| 24 | `EDuplicateDestination` | A fee split names the same recipient twice. |
| 25 | `EInvalidCreatorRecipient` | The creator recipient address is zero. |
| 26 | `EInvalidAccountCommitment` | The account commitment is not 32 bytes. |
| 27 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimPublicKey` | The claim signer key is neither empty nor 32 bytes. |
| 28 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimAttestation` | The claim attestation is unexpected or malformed. |
| 29 | `ECreatorClaimExpired` | The claim attestation has expired. |
| 30 | `ECreatorNotSender` | The sender is not the creator recipient. |
| 31 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimSignature` | The claim attestation's signature does not verify. |
| 32 | `EQuoteNotAllowed` | The Quote is not admitted for new launches. |
| 33 | `EInvalidVirtualQuote` | The virtual Quote reserve is zero, which would let the first purchase take the whole curve. |
| 34 | `EZeroOpeningRoundBid` | An opening-round bid is zero. |
| 35 | `EInvalidCreationFee` | The creation fee paid is not exactly the configured one. |
| 36 | `EPartnerNotAccepted` | New launches may not name this Blast partner. |
| 37 | `EPartnerMismatch` | The call does not name exactly the launch's partner. |

### `blast_fun::allocation`

Migration allocation plans, LP-fee splits, and their exact apportionment.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/allocation.move

#### Types

```move
/// One address paid at migration, with its shares of the Meme supply and the final Quote reserve.
public struct Recipient has copy, drop, store {
    destination: address,
    meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: bps::Bps,
}

/// How migration divides the Meme supply and the final Quote reserve between the curve, the pool,
/// and the recipients. Each asset sums to 10,000 once Blast's allocation is added.
public struct AllocationPlan has copy, drop, store {
    curve_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
    protocol_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    protocol_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipients: vector<Recipient>,
}

/// Blast's one-time Meme and Quote shares, accrued as protocol fees at migration.
public struct ProtocolAllocation has copy, drop, store {
    meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: bps::Bps,
}

/// One LP-fee recipient and its share.
public struct Route has copy, drop, store {
    destination: address,
    bps: bps::Bps,
}

/// The creator's split of every LP-fee collection after Blast's share, applied to both assets.
/// The burn part's Meme is burned at collection and its Quote buys Meme back to burn. The parts
/// sum to 10,000.
public struct FeeSplit has copy, drop, store {
    creator_bps: bps::Bps,
    auto_lp_bps: bps::Bps,
    rewards_bps: bps::Bps,
    burn_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipients: vector<Route>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
public fun recipient(destination: address, meme_bps: bps::Bps, quote_bps: bps::Bps): Recipient

/// The curve and the pool need positive Meme shares; Blast's allocation is added at finalization.
public fun plan(
    curve_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    lp_quote_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipients: vector<Recipient>,
): AllocationPlan

public fun route(destination: address, bps: bps::Bps): Route

public fun fee_split(
    creator_bps: bps::Bps,
    auto_lp_bps: bps::Bps,
    rewards_bps: bps::Bps,
    burn_bps: bps::Bps,
    recipients: vector<Route>,
): FeeSplit

public fun recipients(self: &FeeSplit): &vector<Route>

public fun destination(self: &Route): address

/// Splits `total` into the creator, auto-LP, rewards, burn, and per-recipient amounts, exactly.
public fun apportion_fee_split(self: &FeeSplit, total: u64): (u64, u64, u64, u64, vector<u64>)
```
