### `blast_fun::blast_fun`

Canonical package provenance, publication bootstrap, and operational generation.  The one-time witness seeds the generation and claims the Publisher. Both stay in owned bootstrap custody until package administration seals the native capabilities.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/blast_fun.move

#### Types

```move
/// One-time witness: it seeds the package generation and claims this package's Publisher.
public struct BLAST_FUN() has drop;

/// Publication-only custody; it cannot supply the PackageVersion required by launch activity.
public struct Bootstrap has key {
    id: UID,
    publisher: Publisher,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_FUN>,
}

/// Singleton operational package generation.
public struct PackageVersion has key {
    id: UID,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_FUN>,
}
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: Current package generation accepted by every protected mutation.
- `NEXT_PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 2`: The generation this bytecode hands over to in a governed upgrade.

### `blast_fun::blast_fun_domain`

blast.fun's administration roles in the shared Blast ACL, shared with the migrators.  A role is a type. An `AdminCap` holding `Role` signs in to `AdminWitness<Role>`, and a function's witness parameter names the one role it accepts, so no role authorizes another's actions and a role from any other package cannot reach these operations.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/blast_fun_domain.move

#### Types

```move
/// Authorizes and commits package upgrades, and makes a package immutable.
public struct UpgradeAdmin {}

/// Revokes and reissues a launch's creator capabilities.
public struct CreatorAdmin {}

/// Swaps a vault's burn Quote for Meme to burn.
public struct BuybackAdmin {}

/// Chooses where Blast is paid and Blast's share of future launches, and claims Blast's migration
/// residuals from the migrators.
public struct TreasuryAdmin {}

/// Sets Blast's creation and trade fees, its fee share, and the partners new launches may name.
public struct FeeAdmin {}

/// Admits or removes the Quotes and Meme decimals new launches may use.
public struct ListingAdmin {}

/// Admits or removes migration adapters.
public struct AdapterAdmin {}

/// Replaces the key that signs account claims.
public struct ClaimSignerAdmin {}

/// Publishes holder-reward rounds.
public struct RewardsAdmin {}
```

### `blast_fun::bps`

Validated basis-points values and explicit rounded application.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/lib/bps.move

#### Types

```move
/// A rate from zero through 10,000 basis points; `new` is the only way to build one.
public struct Bps(u64) has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
public fun new(value: u64): Bps

public fun value(self: Bps): u64

/// Applies the rate to `amount`, rounding up; the result is at most `amount`.
public fun apply_up(self: Bps, amount: u64): u64
```

### `blast_fun::constants`

Package-wide protocol constants exposed as zero-cost macros.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `basis_points_denominator: u64 = 10_000`: Denominator for protocol rates expressed in basis points.
- `max_recipients: u64 = 16`: Maximum recipients in an allocation plan or an LP-fee split.
- `max_launch_fee_bps: u64 = 1_000`: Maximum LaunchConfig trade-fee rate for either the meme or quote asset.
- `max_sell_burn_bps: u64 = 5_000`: Maximum creator-selected share of post-fee Meme sell input reserved for burn.
- `min_opening_round_ms: u64 = 60_000`: Shortest opening round a creator may choose.
- `max_opening_round_ms: u64 = 300_000`: Longest opening round a creator may choose.
- `max_meme_symbol_length: u64 = 32`: Maximum Meme symbol length in bytes. Venues copy the symbol into pool and position objects, which Sui caps in size.
- `meme_total_supply_whole_tokens: u64 = 1_000_000_000`: Exact whole-token supply minted for every generated Meme currency.
- `ed25519_public_key_length: u64 = 32`: Canonical Ed25519 public-key length.
- `account_commitment_length: u64 = 32`: Byte length of an opaque Blast account commitment.

### `blast_fun::creator_authority`

Creator recipients, the one-time claim they authorize, and the revocable caps it issues.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/creator_authority.move

#### Types

```move
/// Who may claim a launch's creator caps: an address, or a Blast account the backend attests.
public enum CreatorRecipient has copy, drop, store {
    Address(address),
    Account(vector<u8>),
}

/// Authority over one launch's curve creator fees; the launch honors only the cap ID it records.
public struct CurveFeeCap<phantom Meme> has key, store {
    id: UID,
}

/// Authority over one coin's metadata; the launch honors only the cap ID it records.
public struct BlastMetadataCap<phantom Meme> has key, store {
    id: UID,
}

/// The BCS message the Blast backend signs for an account claim.
public struct CreatorClaimMessage has drop {
    meme: TypeName,
    account_commitment: vector<u8>,
    claimant: address,
    expiry_ms: u64,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
public fun new_address(recipient: address): CreatorRecipient

public fun new_account(account_commitment: vector<u8>): CreatorRecipient

/// Deletes a curve-fee cap. Deleting the live cap leaves curve fees unclaimable until an
/// administrator reassigns the cap.
public fun destroy_curve_fee_cap<Meme>(self: CurveFeeCap<Meme>)

/// Deletes a metadata cap. Deleting the live cap freezes the metadata until an administrator
/// reassigns the cap.
public fun destroy_metadata_cap<Meme>(self: BlastMetadataCap<Meme>)
```

### `blast_fun::events`

Launchpad event payloads and their package-only emitters.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/lib/events.move

#### Events

```move
/// Blast's one-time fee share of the Meme supply and final Quote reserve of launches finalized
/// from now on. Finalized launches keep the shares recorded in `LaunchCreated.allocation_plan`.
public struct ProtocolAllocationSet has copy, drop {
    meme_bps: u64,
    quote_bps: u64,
}

public struct MemeDecimalsSet has copy, drop {
    decimals: u8,
    allowed: bool,
}

/// Trade fees future launches snapshot.
public struct LaunchTradeFeesChanged has copy, drop {
    quote_fee_bps: u64,
    meme_fee_bps: u64,
}

/// A Quote type was admitted to (`allowed = true`) or removed from (`allowed = false`) future
/// launches. Existing launches keep trading in it.
public struct QuoteSet has copy, drop {
    quote: TypeName,
    allowed: bool,
}

public struct MigrationWitnessSet has copy, drop {
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    allowed: bool,
}

/// Blast's live share of every curve trade fee.
public struct ProtocolFeeShareChanged(u64) has copy, drop;

/// The account-claim signer's public key; empty when revoked.
public struct CreatorClaimSignerSet(vector<u8>) has copy, drop;

/// The address every later protocol fee claim pays Blast's share to.
public struct TreasuryChanged(address) has copy, drop;

/// The SUI, in MIST, every launch created afterward pays.
public struct CreationFeeChanged(u64) has copy, drop;

/// New launches may name the partner from now on, or its pending removal was cancelled.
public struct PartnerAdded has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
}

/// New launches may name the partner until `accepted_until_ms`; launches that name it keep paying it.
public struct PartnerRemoved has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
    accepted_until_ms: u64,
}

public struct CreatorCapsClaimed has copy, drop {
    meme: TypeName,
    curve_fee_cap_id: ID,
    blast_metadata_cap_id: ID,
}

public struct CurveFeeCapReassigned has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    curve_fee_cap_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
}

public struct MetadataCapReassigned has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    blast_metadata_cap_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
}

public struct MemeMetadataUpdated has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    icon_url: String,
}

/// A generated package created its currency and launch ticket. The supply is one billion whole
/// tokens at `decimals`.
public struct LaunchTicketCreated has copy, drop {
    ticket_id: ID,
    meme: TypeName,
    decimals: u8,
    metadata_cap_id: ID,
    creator: creator_authority::CreatorRecipient,
    burnable: bool,
    sell_burn_bps: u64,
}

/// A launch was created from `ticket_id` with these settings; a zero `opening_round_ms` has no
/// opening round. The creator paid `creation_fee` SUI, held with Blast's fees on the launch;
/// `partner_id` is the launch's partner for good, if it names one.
public struct LaunchCreated has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    ticket_id: ID,
    quote: TypeName,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    pool_tick_spacing: u32,
    pool_fee_rate: u64,
    lp_fee_split: allocation::FeeSplit,
    virtual_quote: u64,
    graduation_target: u64,
    quote_fee_bps: u64,
    meme_fee_bps: u64,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    creation_fee: u64,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

public struct LaunchShared has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    public_start_ms: u64,
}

/// Quote joined a launch's opening round from the sender; `bids` is the pot after it.
public struct OpeningRoundJoined has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    quote: u64,
    bids: u64,
}

/// The opening round closed: its `bids` bought `meme` from the curve, in the same transaction's
/// `Bought` when there is one, and left `quote` to refund. Both are delivered pro rata.
public struct OpeningRoundSettled has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    bids: u64,
    meme: u64,
    quote: u64,
}

/// `bidder`'s share of the opening round, for its `bid`, was sent to it.
public struct OpeningRoundDelivered has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    bidder: address,
    bid: u64,
    meme: u64,
    quote: u64,
}

/// A curve purchase; reserves are after the purchase. Purchases before `LaunchShared` are the
/// creator's, made in the transaction that creates the launch; the one beside
/// `OpeningRoundSettled` is the opening round's pot.
public struct Bought has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    quote_in: u64,
    meme_out_gross: u64,
    meme_out_net: u64,
    quote_refund: u64,
    protocol_meme_fee: u64,
    creator_meme_fee: u64,
    protocol_quote_fee: u64,
    creator_quote_fee: u64,
    meme_reserve: u64,
    real_quote_reserve: u64,
}

/// A curve sale; reserves are after the sale.
public struct Sold has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_in_gross: u64,
    pending_burn: u64,
    quote_out_gross: u64,
    protocol_meme_fee: u64,
    creator_meme_fee: u64,
    protocol_quote_fee: u64,
    creator_quote_fee: u64,
    meme_reserve: u64,
    real_quote_reserve: u64,
}

/// One recipient's allocation, paid when migration begins.
public struct MigrationAllocationPaid has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    destination: address,
    meme: u64,
    quote: u64,
}

/// Migration committed: the adapter received `meme` and `quote` for the pool, and `disposed_meme`
/// was burned (or sent to `@0x0` under a fixed supply).
public struct Migrated has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme: u64,
    quote: u64,
    disposed_meme: u64,
    total_supply_after: u64,
}

public struct CreatorFeesClaimed has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// `treasury` was paid Blast's `meme_amount` and `quote_amount` and the creation fee's
/// `sui_amount`; the launch's partner, if it names one, was paid the partner amounts in the same
/// claim. Anyone may claim, so the treasury need not be the sender.
public struct ProtocolFeesClaimed has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    treasury: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    sui_amount: u64,
    partner_meme_amount: u64,
    partner_quote_amount: u64,
    partner_sui_amount: u64,
}

/// Blast's one-time migration Meme and Quote fee joined the launch's protocol ledger.
public struct ProtocolFeesAccrued has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}
```

### `blast_fun::fees`

The protocol and creator fee balances a launch holds.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/fees.move

#### Types

```move
/// Both parties' trade fees and every Blast fee held by the launch. The creation fee is SUI
/// whatever the Quote; the one-time migration fee accrues in the Meme and Quote balances.
public struct FeeLedger<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has store {
    protocol_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    creator_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    protocol_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    creator_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    protocol_sui: Balance<sui::SUI>,
}
```

### `blast_fun::launch`

Launch construction, the bonding curve, and the migration handoff.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/launch.move

#### Types

```move
public enum Lifecycle has copy, drop, store {
    OpeningRound,
    Live,
    MigrationReady,
    Migrated,
}

/// Dynamic-field name of one bidder's undelivered opening-round Quote.
public struct OpeningRoundBidKey(address) has copy, drop, store;

/// One launch: its curve, its settings, and custody until migration.
///
/// A launch with an opening round starts in `OpeningRound`. Until `opening_round_ms` after share,
/// Quote joins one pot and nothing trades; settling buys from the curve once with the whole pot, and
/// each bidder is delivered its pro-rata share of the Meme bought and of any Quote refunded.
public struct Launch<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    lifecycle: Lifecycle,
    public_start_ms: Option<u64>,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    /// Total Quote of the opening-round bids not yet delivered.
    opening_round_bids: u64,
    /// The pot until settlement, then the Quote it left to refund.
    opening_round_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    opening_round_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    sell_burn_bps: bps::Bps,
    virtual_quote: u64,
    graduation_target: u64,
    quote_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    pool_tick_spacing: u32,
    pool_fee_rate: u64,
    lp_fee_split: allocation::FeeSplit,
    atomic_supply: u64,
    meme_reserve: Balance<Meme>,
    real_quote_reserve: Balance<Quote>,
    pending_burn: Balance<Meme>,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
    allocated_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    fee_ledger: fees::FeeLedger<Meme, Quote>,
    metadata_cap: MetadataCap<Meme>,
    creator: Option<creator_authority::CreatorRecipient>,
    curve_fee_cap_id: Option<ID>,
    blast_metadata_cap_id: Option<ID>,
    /// The Blast partner named at creation, paid its share of every fee Blast takes on this
    /// launch. It never changes.
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// Hot potato from `new` to `finalize`, collecting the creator's settings.
public struct LaunchInitializer<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> {
    ticket: launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    migration_witness: TypeName,
    pool_tick_spacing: u32,
    pool_fee_rate: u64,
    quote_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    virtual_quote: Option<u64>,
    graduation_target: Option<u64>,
    allocation_plan: Option<allocation::AllocationPlan>,
    lp_fee_split: Option<allocation::FeeSplit>,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a launch for the adapter that constructs `Witness`, at the creator's pool tier in that
/// venue's units. The Quote, the adapter, and the decimals must be admitted.
public fun new<Meme, Quote, Witness: drop>(
    ticket: launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    _: Witness,
    pool_tick_spacing: u32,
    pool_fee_rate: u64,
): LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>

/// Lends the treasury capability to the starting adapter, e.g. for a pool reservation.
public fun treasury_cap_mut<Meme, Quote, Witness: drop>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    _: Witness,
): &mut TreasuryCap<Meme>

/// Sets the virtual Quote reserve the curve starts from, which prices the first purchase.
public fun set_virtual_quote<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    virtual_quote: u64,
)

/// Sets the Quote reserve at which the curve closes.
public fun set_graduation_target<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    graduation_target: u64,
)

public fun set_allocation_plan<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
)

public fun set_lp_fee_split<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    lp_fee_split: allocation::FeeSplit,
)

/// Sets how long the opening round runs after share, within the protocol's bounds. Zero, the
/// default, has no opening round: trading starts at share.
public fun set_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    opening_round_duration_ms: u64,
)

/// Names the launch's Blast partner, one new launches may name. From `finalize` on it is the
/// launch's partner for good, paid its share of every fee Blast takes on the launch when Blast
/// claims them.
public fun set_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Checks every setting, adds Blast's allocation to the plan, fixes the canonical supply in the
/// Coin Registry, and splits the Meme into the curve reserve and the migration allocations.
/// `creation_fee` must be exactly the configured fee; it joins Blast's fees on the launch. The
/// version check also rejects stale finalization in a transaction that used current intake.
public fun finalize<Meme, Quote>(
    self: LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    creation_fee: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Launch<Meme, Quote>

/// Shares the launch. Public time starts now: trading, or the opening round, which ends
/// `opening_round_ms` later.
public fun share<Meme, Quote>(
    self: Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Returns the creator's `(tick_spacing, fee_rate)` pool tier, in the adapter's venue units.
public fun pool_tier<Meme, Quote>(self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>): (u32, u64)

public fun lp_fee_split<Meme, Quote>(self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>): allocation::FeeSplit

/// Returns the Blast partner named at creation, which the launch's LP vault inherits.
public fun partner_id<Meme, Quote>(self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>): Option<ID>

/// Authenticates the creator recipient and issues both creator capabilities.
public fun claim_creator_caps<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    account_attestation: Option<vector<u8>>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>, creator_authority::BlastMetadataCap<Meme>)

/// Retires the pending claim or the live curve-fee cap and sends a fresh cap to `recipient`.
/// Unclaimed curve fees follow the new cap.
public fun reassign_curve_fee_cap<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    recipient: address,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Retires the pending claim or the live metadata cap and sends a fresh cap to `recipient`.
public fun reassign_metadata_cap<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    recipient: address,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

public fun set_name<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    blast_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::BlastMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    name: String,
)

public fun set_description<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    blast_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::BlastMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    description: String,
)

public fun set_icon_url<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    blast_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::BlastMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    icon_url: String,
)

/// Adds `quote_in` to the sender's opening-round bid. Before share only the creator's own
/// transaction can reach the launch, so the creator's bid joins the same pot at the same price.
public fun join_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Closes the ended opening round: buys from the curve once with the whole pot, at the usual fees
/// and graduation cap, and holds the Meme bought and any Quote refunded for delivery. A pot too
/// small to buy one Meme atom is held whole for refund unless it reaches graduation. Anyone may settle.
public fun settle_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Sends `bidder` its share of the settled opening round: the Meme bought and the Quote refunded,
/// pro rata to its bid among the undelivered bids and rounded down, so the last delivery takes the
/// remainder. Anyone may deliver, in any later lifecycle.
public fun deliver_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    bidder: address,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Buys Meme with Quote; Quote beyond the graduation target is refunded. Trading opens at share,
/// or at settlement after an opening round; before share only the creator's transaction can buy.
/// A target-reaching buy may return zero Meme when `min_meme_out` is zero.
public fun buy<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    min_meme_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Sells Meme for Quote; the sell-burn share of the input waits in `pending_burn`.
public fun sell<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    meme_in: Coin<Meme>,
    min_quote_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

public fun claim_creator_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    curve_fee_cap: &creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Pays the runtime configuration's treasury Blast's fees on a launch that names no partner: its
/// trade fees, the creation fee, and the one-time migration fee. Anyone may claim.
public fun claim_protocol_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays Blast's fees on a launch that names `partner`: the partner its share of each, then the
/// runtime configuration's treasury the rest, in the same call. Anyone may claim.
public fun claim_protocol_fees_with_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays every project recipient, accrues Blast's one-time Meme and Quote fee in the launch ledger,
/// burns the curve's unsold Meme and pending sell-burn (or sends them to `@0x0` when the supply is
/// fixed), and returns the pool's share to the stored adapter.
public fun migrate<Meme, Quote, Witness: drop>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    _: Witness,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Balance<Meme>, Balance<Quote>)

/// Aborts unless `curve_fee_cap` is the curve-fee cap this launch currently honors.
public fun assert_curve_fee_cap<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    curve_fee_cap: &creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
)
```

### `blast_fun::launch_config`

Launch policy each new launch snapshots.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/launch_config.move

#### Types

```move
/// Admitted decimals, Quotes, and migration adapters; the trade fees; Blast's one-time migration
/// allocation; the SUI every launch pays at creation; and the Blast partners new launches may
/// name. Each creator picks the virtual Quote reserve their curve starts from.
public struct LaunchConfig has key {
    id: UID,
    meme_decimals: VecSet<u8>,
    quotes: Table<TypeName, bool>,
    quote_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    migration_witnesses: VecSet<TypeName>,
    protocol_allocation: allocation::ProtocolAllocation,
    /// In MIST.
    creation_fee: u64,
}

/// Dynamic-field key of a Blast partner new launches may name. Its value is the time the partner
/// stops being accepted: `u64::MAX` until Blast removes it.
public struct PartnerKey(ID) has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Sets Blast's fee share of future launches' Meme supply and final Quote reserve. The shares
/// leave room for the curve and the pool; finalized launches keep their snapshotted shares.
public fun set_protocol_allocation(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::TreasuryAdmin>,
    meme_bps: bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: bps::Bps,
)

public fun set_meme_decimals_allowed(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::ListingAdmin>,
    decimals: u8,
    allowed: bool,
)

/// Admits or removes `Quote` for future launches; existing launches keep trading in it.
public fun set_quote_allowed<Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::ListingAdmin>,
    allowed: bool,
)

/// Sets the trade fees launches created afterward snapshot.
public fun set_trade_fees(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    quote_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: bps::Bps,
)

/// Sets the SUI, in MIST, every launch created afterward pays.
public fun set_creation_fee(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    creation_fee: u64,
)

/// Lets new launches name `partner`, at once. Adding a partner whose removal is pending cancels
/// the removal; adding a removed partner accepts it again.
public fun add_partner(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
)

/// Stops new launches naming `partner` after the notice Blast gives for every change to a
/// partner, `blast_partners::delay_ms()`. Launches that already name it keep paying it.
public fun remove_partner(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Admits or removes a migration adapter's witness type. An admitted adapter can start launches
/// and receives their liquidity at migration; existing launches keep their witness.
///
/// Framework types are rejected because anyone can construct them.
public fun set_migration_witness_allowed<MigrationWitness: drop>(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun_domain::AdapterAdmin>,
    allowed: bool,
)
```

## API reference: `blast_fun_migrators` (Migration and LP vaults)

Not yet published on mainnet. Its interface may change before publication.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

### `blast_fun_migrators::blast_events`

Typed replay facts for vault custody, the LP-fee policy and split, auto-LP, holder rewards, Cetus pool reservations, and residual claims.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/blast_events.move

#### Events

```move
/// Blast's default pair (no `meme`) or one coin's pair changed; absent old/new pairs represent a
/// coin's own pair being created or removed.
public struct LpFeePolicyChanged has copy, drop {
    meme: Option<TypeName>,
    old_meme_bps: Option<u64>,
    old_quote_bps: Option<u64>,
    new_meme_bps: Option<u64>,
    new_quote_bps: Option<u64>,
}

/// The protocol share of every later collection pays a new address.
public struct LpFeeDestinationChanged has copy, drop {
    old_destination: address,
    new_destination: address,
}

/// Records discovery and typed position custody for one completed vault: the position's
/// `liquidity`, the handoff the venue returned as protocol residuals, and the creator's fee split
/// it holds from migration.
public struct VaultCreated has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    pool_id: ID,
    position_id: ID,
    venue: TypeName,
    meme: TypeName,
    quote: TypeName,
    residual_meme: u64,
    residual_quote: u64,
    liquidity: u128,
    fee_split: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
}

/// One nonzero collection split under the vault's split: Blast's share, the creator, auto-LP,
/// rewards, and burn shares, and every recipient's amount in the split's recipient order.
/// `burn_meme` was burned; `burn_quote` waits for a buyback.
public struct FeesCollected has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    gross_meme: u64,
    gross_quote: u64,
    /// Where Blast's share was paid, or none when a partnered vault holds it for the partner claim.
    protocol_destination: Option<address>,
    protocol_meme: u64,
    protocol_quote: u64,
    creator_meme: u64,
    creator_quote: u64,
    auto_lp_meme: u64,
    auto_lp_quote: u64,
    rewards_meme: u64,
    rewards_quote: u64,
    burn_meme: u64,
    burn_quote: u64,
    recipient_meme: vector<u64>,
    recipient_quote: vector<u64>,
}

/// Auto-LP added these amounts to the position; the rest waits in the vault.
public struct AutoLiquidityAdded has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    meme_pending: u64,
    quote_pending: u64,
}

/// A buyback admin swapped `quote_spent` of the burn Quote for `meme_burned` Meme and burned it;
/// `quote_pending` still waits.
public struct BuybackBurned has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    quote_spent: u64,
    meme_burned: u64,
    quote_pending: u64,
}

/// The vault opened the separate position auto-LP adds to.
public struct AutoLpPositionOpened has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    position_id: ID,
}

/// The live curve-fee cap holder committed a new fee split.
public struct FeeSplitChanged has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    old_fee_split: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
    new_fee_split: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
}

/// The live curve-fee cap holder claimed the creator's accrued LP fees.
public struct CreatorFeesClaimed has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// A holder-reward allocation commitment, its reserved funds, and the vault's unreserved rewards.
public struct RoundPublished has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    round_id: ID,
    number: u64,
    start_checkpoint: u64,
    end_checkpoint: u64,
    root: vector<u8>,
    manifest_digest: vector<u8>,
    leaf_count: u64,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    meme_unallocated: u64,
    quote_unallocated: u64,
}

/// A completed holder-reward payout and both remaining round balances.
public struct RewardPaid has copy, drop {
    round_id: ID,
    index: u64,
    beneficiary: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    meme_remaining: u64,
    quote_remaining: u64,
}

/// Records a protocol migration-residual claim.
public struct ProtocolFeesClaimed has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    meme: TypeName,
    quote: TypeName,
    claimant: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// A partnered vault paid the Blast LP fees it held: `partner_meme` and `partner_quote` to the
/// launch's partner, and the rest, `protocol_meme` and `protocol_quote`, to `protocol_destination`.
public struct ProtocolLpFeesClaimed has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    protocol_destination: address,
    protocol_meme: u64,
    protocol_quote: u64,
    partner_meme: u64,
    partner_quote: u64,
}

/// Records Cetus pool creation reserved for one pair at the tick spacing its migration uses.
public struct CetusPoolReserved has copy, drop {
    meme: TypeName,
    quote: TypeName,
    pool_creation_cap_id: ID,
    tick_spacing: u32,
}
```

### `blast_fun_migrators::blast_fun_migrators`

Canonical package provenance witness for the aggregate migrators package, and its own operational generation.  `init` seeds the generation from the one-time witness and then claims the Publisher with it, so no other package can create this package's generation. The marker never declares an administration role: Migrators reuses the Launchpad's roles in the shared Blast ACL and owns only its package-local state. Migrators does not treat the Launchpad generation as its own; a composed call that mutates both packages supplies both version objects, because each package checks only the transitions it implements.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/blast_fun_migrators.move

#### Types

```move
/// One-time witness: it seeds the package generation and claims this package's Publisher.
public struct BLAST_FUN_MIGRATORS() has drop;

/// Singleton operational package generation.
public struct PackageVersion has key {
    id: UID,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_FUN_MIGRATORS>,
}
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: Current package generation accepted by every protected mutation.
- `NEXT_PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 2`: The generation this bytecode hands over to in a governed upgrade.

### `blast_fun_migrators::blast_holder_rewards`

Holder rewards: rounds funded from a vault's rewards share and paid by Merkle proof.  Blast's off-chain system turns checkpointed holder balances into a Merkle allocation, and a Blast administrator publishes it as a round that reserves its budget from the vault. Anyone can relay a proof afterwards; each leaf pays its committed beneficiary once.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/blast_holder_rewards.move

#### Types

```move
/// Independently funded claims that remain available without the vault or the administrator.
public struct Round<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    vault: ID,
    number: u64,
    root: vector<u8>,
    leaf_count: u64,
    claimed: vector<u256>,
    meme: Balance<Meme>,
    quote: Balance<Quote>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Reserves part of the vault's rewards balance for a committed allocation and shares the round.
public fun publish_round<Meme, Quote>(
    vault: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::RewardsAdmin>,
    number: u64,
    start_checkpoint: u64,
    end_checkpoint: u64,
    root: vector<u8>,
    manifest_digest: vector<u8>,
    leaf_count: u64,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Anyone may relay a proof; delivery is only to its committed beneficiary.
public fun claim<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Round<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    index: u64,
    beneficiary: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    proof: vector<vector<u8>>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EWrongRound` | 0 | Round number must match the vault's next round. |
| `EInvalidInterval` | 1 | Checkpoint interval must be nonempty and contiguous with the previous round. |
| `EInvalidCommitment` | 2 | Root and manifest digest must each contain exactly 32 bytes. |
| `EInvalidLeafCount` | 3 | Round must contain between 1 and 65,536 leaves. |
| `EEmptyBudget` | 4 | At least one reward amount must be nonzero. |
| `EInvalidIndex` | 5 | Claim index must be less than the committed leaf count. |
| `EAlreadyClaimed` | 6 | This allocation has already been paid. |
| `EInvalidBeneficiary` | 7 | Beneficiary must not be the zero address. |
| `EInvalidProof` | 8 | Proof must match the committed recipient, amounts and domain. |

### `blast_fun_migrators::bluefin`

Bluefin launch start, migration, fee collection with auto-LP, settled fee-split updates, and buybacks over custodied concentrated-liquidity principal.  Bluefin pools are keyed by their exact type-parameter order, so this module always creates and expects `Pool<Meme, Quote>` with Meme as coin A.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/bluefin.move

#### Types

```move
/// Sealed adapter identity selected by a Blast launch.
public struct Witness() has drop;

/// Sealed marker for the Bluefin position attached to the common vault.
public struct Venue() has drop;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a Bluefin launch in `Quote` at the creator's tier; the core aborts unless it admits
/// Bluefin and the Quote.
///
/// Bluefin checks the tier only when migration creates the pool, and a launch cannot change its
/// tier, so the same bounds apply here first. The creator completes the returned initializer with
/// `launch::finalize`.
public fun new<Meme, Quote>(
    ticket: blast_fun::launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    package_version: &blast_fun::blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    config: &blast_fun::launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    tick_spacing: u32,
    fee_rate: u64,
): blast_fun::launch::LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>

/// Migrates a MigrationReady launch into a new full-range pool at the launch's tier.
///
/// The opening price derives from the handed-off balances, which seed the position on the side
/// `is_meme_seed_side` chooses. `creation_fee` is paid whole, and Bluefin aborts unless it is
/// exactly the configured SUI fee. The position and the venue residuals stay in a shared vault
/// with no withdrawal path. The caller receives no object; Bluefin records it as the new pool's
/// manager, a role limited to the pool's reward emissions and to handing the role on (ADR 0088).
public fun migrate<Meme, Quote>(
    launch: &mut blast_fun::launch::Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    package_version: &blast_fun::blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    quote_currency: &Currency<Quote>,
    bluefin_config: &mut config::GlobalConfig,
    creation_fee: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Collects the custodied position's fees, splits them, burns the burn share's Meme, and adds the
/// auto-LP share back to the position. Anyone may call it.
public fun collect_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    policy: &lp_fee_policy::LpFeePolicy,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    bluefin_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<Meme, Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Settles the custodied position's accrued fees under the current split, then commits `proposed`.
public fun settle_and_update_fee_split<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    policy: &lp_fee_policy::LpFeePolicy,
    launch: &blast_fun::launch::Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    curve_fee_cap: &blast_fun::creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    bluefin_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<Meme, Quote>,
    proposed: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Swaps the vault's burn Quote for Meme in its pool and burns it, under a buyback admin. Aborts
/// unless the swap returns at least `min_meme_out`; the admin sets it from an off-chain price,
/// since anyone can move the pool's price within a transaction.
public fun buyback_and_burn<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    admin_witness: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::BuybackAdmin>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    bluefin_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<Meme, Quote>,
    min_meme_out: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EPositionPoolMismatch` | 0 | Custodied position must belong to the supplied pool. |
| `EInvalidTier` | 1 | Bluefin tier needs a tick spacing in 1..=400 and a fee rate in 1..=20,000. |

### `blast_fun_migrators::cetus`

Cetus launch start, pool-creation reservation, migration into vault custody, and collection.  Anyone holding Meme can create a Cetus pool, and Cetus allows one pool per pair and tick spacing, so a buyer could pre-create the migration pool at a price of their choosing. Starting the launch therefore mints the Meme type's single Cetus `PoolCreationCap` from the ticket's treasury capability, before any Meme can leave the ticket, and registers the pair at the creator's tick spacing; afterwards only that capability or Cetus's pool-manager role can create the pair's pool there. Trusting that role is a venue-operator assumption: a pool it creates first makes the pair's migration abort, and only a migrators upgrade could recover the launch. The capability stays in `VenueConfig` under a key only this module constructs, with no extraction or unregistration path.  Migration burns the full-range position through Cetus LP Burn, so Cetus itself records the launch liquidity as permanently locked; the vault keeps the `CetusLPBurnProof`, which can only collect fees. A burned position cannot receive liquidity, so auto-LP adds to a second full-range position the vault opens on first use and keeps with no removal path.  Cetus orders a pool's coin types by type name. Each route after `new` takes the pool's coin types as `CoinA` and `CoinB` beside the launch's `Meme` and `Quote`, proves they are the same pair, and retypes balances between the two orders through a checked dynamic-field round trip (ADR 0100).

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/cetus.move

#### Types

```move
/// Sealed adapter identity selected by a Blast launch.
public struct Witness() has drop;

/// Sealed marker for the Cetus position attached to the common vault.
public struct Venue() has drop;

/// Sealed `VenueConfig` object-field name for the Meme type's Cetus `PoolCreationCap`.
///
/// The capability is a dynamic object field, so it keeps the ID that Cetus's permission registry
/// and every `CetusPoolReserved` event record, and stays readable by that ID.
public struct CreationCapKey<phantom Meme>() has copy, drop, store;

/// Transient dynamic-field name `cast` uses to retype a coin or balance.
public struct CastKey() has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a Cetus launch in `Quote` at the creator's `tick_spacing` and reserves Cetus pool
/// creation for the pair.
///
/// Cetus fixes the fee rate of each registered tick spacing, and the launch records both. The
/// Meme type's single `PoolCreationCap` is minted from the ticket's treasury capability before
/// any Meme can leave it, and the pair is registered at `tick_spacing`. Aborts, leaving Cetus
/// unchanged, when Cetus does not register the spacing or refuses the pair at it, so the creator
/// can choose another tier or adapter instead. The creator completes the returned initializer
/// with `launch::finalize`.
public fun new<Meme, Quote>(
    ticket: blast_fun::launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    package_version: &blast_fun::blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    config: &blast_fun::launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    venue_config: &mut venue_config::VenueConfig,
    cetus_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pools: &mut factory::Pools,
    tick_spacing: u32,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): blast_fun::launch::LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>

/// Migrates a MigrationReady launch into vault custody. `CoinA` and `CoinB` name the launch's
/// Meme and Quote in Cetus's canonical coin order.
///
/// Creates the pair's pool with the reserved capability at the launch's tick spacing, priced from
/// the handed-off balances, seeds full-range liquidity with exactly those balances on the side
/// `is_coin_a_seed_side` chooses, and burns the position; Cetus returns what it does not take as
/// residual. Any Cetus refusal, including a tier Cetus no longer registers, aborts the whole
/// migration and leaves the launch MigrationReady.
public fun migrate<Meme, Quote, CoinA, CoinB>(
    launch: &mut blast_fun::launch::Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    package_version: &blast_fun::blast_fun::PackageVersion,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    venue_config: &venue_config::VenueConfig,
    cetus_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pools: &mut factory::Pools,
    burn_manager: &mut lp_burn::BurnManager,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Collects the vault position's fees from its pool, splits them, burns the burn share's Meme, and
/// adds the auto-LP share back to the position. Anyone may call it. `CoinA` and `CoinB` are the
/// pool's coin order.
public fun collect_fees<Meme, Quote, CoinA, CoinB>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    policy: &lp_fee_policy::LpFeePolicy,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    cetus_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    burn_manager: &lp_burn::BurnManager,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<CoinA, CoinB>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Settles the position's accrued fees under the current split, then commits `proposed`. `CoinA`
/// and `CoinB` are the pool's coin order.
public fun settle_and_update_fee_split<Meme, Quote, CoinA, CoinB>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    policy: &lp_fee_policy::LpFeePolicy,
    launch: &blast_fun::launch::Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    curve_fee_cap: &blast_fun::creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    cetus_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    burn_manager: &lp_burn::BurnManager,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<CoinA, CoinB>,
    proposed: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Swaps the vault's burn Quote for Meme in its pool and burns it, under a buyback admin. Aborts
/// unless the swap returns at least `min_meme_out`; the admin sets it from an off-chain price,
/// since anyone can move the pool's price within a transaction. `CoinA` and `CoinB` are the pool's
/// coin order.
public fun buyback_and_burn<Meme, Quote, CoinA, CoinB>(
    self: &mut vault::LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    admin_witness: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::BuybackAdmin>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    cetus_config: &config::GlobalConfig,
    pool: &mut pool::Pool<CoinA, CoinB>,
    min_meme_out: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EInvalidCoinOrder` | 0 | CoinA and CoinB must follow the Cetus coin order. |
| `EPositionPoolMismatch` | 1 | Pool must be the vault's own pool. |
| `EWrongCoinPair` | 2 | CoinA and CoinB must be exactly the launch's Meme and Quote. |

### `blast_fun_migrators::constants`

Package-wide migrator constants exposed as zero-cost macros.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/constants.move

#### Constants

- `bluefin_max_tick_spacing: u32 = 400`: Bluefin pool creation's own tick-spacing bound (`pool` aborts 1026 above it).
- `bluefin_max_fee_rate: u64 = 20_000`: Bluefin pool creation's own fee-rate bound (`pool` aborts 1027 above it).
- `min_swap_sqrt_price: u128 = 4_295_048_017`: Lowest sqrt price a Cetus or Bluefin swap accepts as its limit; buybacks selling Quote as coin A run to it and rely on the caller's minimum Meme out instead.
- `max_swap_sqrt_price: u128 = 79_226_673_515_401_279_992_447_579_054`: Highest sqrt price a Cetus or Bluefin swap accepts as its limit, for buybacks selling Quote as coin B.
- `q64_shift: u8 = 64`: Fractional bits of a Q64.64 sqrt price.
- `q128_shift: u8 = 128`: Fractional bits of the Q128 price ratio the seed sqrt price is taken from.
- `sqrt_upper_bound_shift: u8 = 96`: Exponent of the integer square-root search's upper bound: a positive u64/u64 Q128 ratio is below 2^192, so its root is below 2^96.
- `auto_lp_margin: u256 = 2`: Atoms of the other asset kept in reserve beyond the estimate, covering the venue's own rounding of the liquidity it derives from the fixed amount.
- `max_reward_leaves: u64 = 65_536`: Maximum leaves in one holder-rewards round.
- `digest_length: u64 = 32`: Byte length of a Blake2b-256 digest: Merkle roots, nodes, and manifest digests.

### `blast_fun_migrators::lp_fee_policy`

Blast's share of the LP fees every migrated position collects.  Bonding-curve trades read the launchpad's `RuntimeConfig`; migrated positions read this object instead, so the two policies change independently. Every collection reads it live: the coin's own pair when an administrator set one, otherwise the default pair, and the current payout destination.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/lp_fee_policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding independent Meme/Quote Blast shares and the address every vault pays
/// the protocol share to. Per-coin entries use original Meme type identity and require no
/// iteration or cardinality cap.
public struct LpFeePolicy has key {
    id: UID,
    destination: address,
    defaults: SharePair,
    coins: Table<TypeName, SharePair>,
}

/// Atomic pair of validated shares; a per-coin entry always replaces both assets together.
public struct SharePair has copy, drop, store {
    meme_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Redirects every later protocol share payout.
public fun set_protocol_destination(
    self: &mut LpFeePolicy,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::TreasuryAdmin>,
    destination: address,
)

/// Changes both default shares for every coin without its own pair, from its next collection.
public fun set_default_shares(
    self: &mut LpFeePolicy,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    meme_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
)

/// Sets both shares for this original Meme type, from its next collection.
/// Setting the current defaults is a real transition because later default changes skip the coin.
public fun set_coin_shares<Meme>(
    self: &mut LpFeePolicy,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    meme_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_fun::bps::Bps,
)

/// Removes the coin's own pair so its later collections use the defaults again.
public fun clear_coin_shares<Meme>(
    self: &mut LpFeePolicy,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::FeeAdmin>,
)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EProtocolDestinationUnchanged` | 0 | Protocol destination must be a new nonzero address. |
| `EProtocolFeeSharesUnchanged` | 1 | LP-fee share update must change the stored pair. |

### `blast_fun_migrators::package_admin`

Sealed custody for the migrators package's Publisher and UpgradeCap.  Migrators shares the Launchpad's administration roles, so its governed transitions take `AdminWitness<UpgradeAdmin>`, the role Launchpad declares. Custody itself stays package-local: advancing Migrators leaves Launchpad on its own generation.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/package_admin.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared custody for this package's framework Publisher and UpgradeCap.
public struct PackageAdmin has key {
    id: UID,
    custody: blast_admin::upgrade_custody::UpgradeCustody<blast_fun_migrators::BLAST_FUN_MIGRATORS>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Validates and permanently seals the migrators Publisher and raw UpgradeCap.
///
/// `upgrade_custody::new` requires this package's Publisher and its never-upgraded cap, and at
/// version one `BLAST_FUN_MIGRATORS` is the package's only one-time witness, so no other module's
/// Publisher can exist.
public fun wrap(publisher: Publisher, upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap, ctx: &mut TxContext)

/// Authorizes the exact package digest under the sealed cap's compatible policy.
///
/// No path narrows that policy: every upgrade commits through `commit_upgrade_and_advance`,
/// whose new bytecode must compile the next generation constants.
public fun authorize_upgrade(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
    digest: vector<u8>,
): UpgradeTicket

/// Commits the native receipt and advances one operational generation at once.
///
/// Every commit advances, so each upgrade must bump both constants in `package_version`: bytecode
/// that still compiles the old generation fails every generation check, `authorize_upgrade`
/// included, and would freeze the package.
public fun commit_upgrade_and_advance(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &mut blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
    receipt: UpgradeReceipt,
)
```

### `blast_fun_migrators::vault`

Sealed dynamic-object custody for migration positions, their protocol residuals, and the balances every LP-fee collection is split into.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/vault.move

#### Types

```move
/// A sealed field name that binds one venue position type to one vault.
public struct PositionKey<phantom Venue>() has copy, drop, store;

/// A sealed field name for the separate position auto-LP adds to on venues whose migration
/// position cannot receive more liquidity (Cetus burns it).
public struct AutoLpPositionKey<phantom Venue>() has copy, drop, store;

/// Shared per-launch custody for one position, its protocol migration residuals, and the balances
/// its LP fees are split into.
///
/// Every collection pays Blast's live share from `LpFeePolicy`, then splits the rest by the
/// creator's `FeeSplit`: the creator share accrues here until the live curve-fee cap claims it,
/// the auto-LP share goes back into the position in the same call (any part the pool does not
/// take waits here for the next call), the rewards share funds holder-reward rounds, and every
/// recipient is paid at once. The burn share's Meme is burned at once and its Quote waits here until
/// a buyback admin swaps it for Meme to burn. The split changes only after the fees accrued under
/// the current one are settled, so each fee follows the split it accrued under. When the launch
/// named a partner, Blast's live share waits here instead, until
/// `claim_protocol_lp_fees_with_partner` pays the partner its cut and Blast the rest.
public struct LpVault<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    pool_id: ID,
    /// The Blast partner the launch named, paid its cut of Blast's LP fees. It never changes.
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
    protocol_meme_residual: Balance<Meme>,
    protocol_quote_residual: Balance<Quote>,
    unpaid_protocol_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    unpaid_protocol_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    fee_split: blast_fun::allocation::FeeSplit,
    creator_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    creator_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    auto_lp_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    auto_lp_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    rewards_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    rewards_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    burn_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    next_round: u64,
    last_checkpoint: Option<u64>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Claims the protocol-owned migration residuals under a treasury admin.
public fun claim_protocol_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_fun::blast_fun_domain::TreasuryAdmin>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Pays the Blast LP fees this vault holds for its launch's partner: the partner its cut of each
/// asset in force now, rounded down, then the `LpFeePolicy`'s current protocol destination the
/// rest. Anyone may claim, since both payees are fixed. Holding nothing is valid, moves nothing,
/// and emits nothing, so a claim can follow any collection.
public fun claim_protocol_lp_fees_with_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    policy: &lp_fee_policy::LpFeePolicy,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Claims the creator's accrued LP-fee share with the launch's live curve-fee cap.
public fun claim_creator_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LpVault<Meme, Quote>,
    migrators_version: &blast_fun_migrators::PackageVersion,
    launch: &blast_fun::launch::Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    curve_fee_cap: &blast_fun::creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ENothingClaimable` | 0 | No protocol migration residuals are available to claim. |
| `EFeeSplitUnchanged` | 1 | Fee split proposal must differ from the current split. |
| `ENoCreatorFees` | 2 | No creator LP fees are available to claim. |
| `EZeroLiquidity` | 3 | Migration position must hold liquidity. |
| `ENoBuybackQuote` | 4 | No burn Quote is waiting to buy Meme back. |
| `EBuybackBelowMinimum` | 5 | Buyback must return at least the minimum Meme. |
| `EPartnerMismatch` | 6 | The partner is not the one the vault's launch named at creation. |

### `blast_fun_migrators::venue_config`

Shared venue state: write-once objects only their venue module can key.  Venue modules add authority-bearing objects (the Meme type's Cetus `PoolCreationCap`) while starting a launch, as dynamic object fields, so each object keeps its ID and stays readable by it. No entry is ever removed, replaced, or borrowed mutably. New venue modules add entries without changing this object's layout.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/migrators/sources/venue_config.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding venue-owned entries.
public struct VenueConfig has key {
    id: UID,
}
```

## API reference: `blast_partners` (Partner codes)

Live on mainnet, published from an earlier revision. The source documented here has changed since; until it is republished, confirm signatures against the live package.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

### `blast_partners::blast_partners`

Blast partner codes, shared by every Blast product.  A partner is one deal: it is paid a share of the fee Blast charges on every trade that names it, in the same transaction. A company holds one `PartnerCap` for all its deals, each a separate partner with its own share. Blast's partner administrator registers partners under a cap, sets each one's share, and can move a partner to another cap; the cap's holder sets where each of its partners is paid. Everything Blast changes takes effect only `PARTNER_CHANGE_DELAY_MS` after it is scheduled, and this package is published immutable, so no one can shorten that delay. The recipient the cap holder sets applies at once.  Products call `pay` with Blast's own fee on a trade. `pay` emits `PartnerPaid` for what the partner received; the product records the trade and the amount in its own event.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/partners/sources/blast_partners.move

#### Types

```move
/// The one administrator role in the shared Blast ACL: register partners,
/// schedule shares, move partners between caps.
public struct PartnerAdmin {}

/// One Blast partner. Shared, and read by immutable reference on every trade that names it.
public struct Partner has key {
    id: UID,
    /// Where the partner's share is sent; set by the live cap's holder.
    recipient: address,
    /// The partner's share of Blast's fee on each trade, in basis points.
    share_bps: blast_fun_timelock::Timelocked<u64>,
    /// The only cap that may set `recipient`; one cap may manage many partners.
    cap_id: blast_fun_timelock::Timelocked<ID>,
}

/// A company's authority over the recipient of every partner bound to it.
public struct PartnerCap has key, store {
    id: UID,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Mints a cap. It controls nothing until Blast registers a partner under it,
/// so anyone may mint one, a company included.
public fun new_cap(ctx: &mut TxContext): PartnerCap

/// Registers and shares a partner managed by the cap `cap_id`, with its share
/// and cap in force at once. Every later change to either waits `PARTNER_CHANGE_DELAY_MS`.
public fun register(
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<PartnerAdmin>,
    cap_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    share_bps: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Schedules the partner's share to become `share_bps` `PARTNER_CHANGE_DELAY_MS` from now.
/// A new schedule replaces a pending one; scheduling the share in force
/// cancels a pending change.
public fun schedule_share(
    self: &mut Partner,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<PartnerAdmin>,
    share_bps: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Schedules the partner to be managed by the cap `cap_id` `PARTNER_CHANGE_DELAY_MS` from
/// now, to replace a lost or stolen cap. Until then the current cap keeps
/// working; a new schedule replaces a pending one, and scheduling the cap in
/// force cancels a pending change.
public fun schedule_cap(
    self: &mut Partner,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<PartnerAdmin>,
    cap_id: ID,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Sets where the partner is paid, at once. Only the live cap may.
public fun set_recipient(self: &mut Partner, cap: &PartnerCap, recipient: address, clock: &Clock)

/// Destroys a cap, live or not.
public fun destroy_cap(cap: PartnerCap)

/// Transfers the partner its share of `fee` (Blast's fee on one trade) as a coin,
/// rounded down so Blast keeps the remainder, emits `PartnerPaid`, and returns the
/// amount sent. Nothing is sent or emitted while the share is zero. `fee`
/// keeps the rest. Anyone calling it pays the partner from their own balance.
public fun pay<T>(self: &Partner, fee: &mut Balance<T>, clock: &Clock, ctx: &mut TxContext): u64

/// The forced delay every change Blast makes to a partner waits. Products use it
/// for their own notice, such as how long a partner they remove stays accepted.
public fun delay_ms(): u64
```

#### Events

```move
/// Emitted after every change to a partner, registration included: its complete terms.
public struct PartnerUpdated has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    share_bps: blast_fun_timelock::Timelocked<u64>,
    cap_id: blast_fun_timelock::Timelocked<ID>,
}

/// Emitted whenever a partner is paid: `amount` of `T` sent to its recipient.
public struct PartnerPaid<phantom T> has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
    amount: u64,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EInvalidRecipient` | 0 | A partner's recipient must not be the zero address. |
| `EShareAboveMax` | 1 | A partner's share must be at most 80% of Blast's fee. |
| `EUnchanged` | 2 | An update must change the value it sets. |
| `ENotLiveCap` | 3 | Only the partner's live cap may set its recipient. |

#### Constants

- `PARTNER_CHANGE_DELAY_MS: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000`: The forced delay before a share or a cap Blast schedules takes effect.
- `MAX_SHARE_BPS: u64 = 8_000`: The largest share of Blast's fee one partner may earn: 80%.
- `BASIS_POINTS: u64 = 10_000`: Basis points in one whole.

## API reference: `blast_boosts_core` (Boosts core)

Live on mainnet, published from an earlier revision. The source documented here has changed since; until it is republished, confirm signatures against the live package.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EZeroAmount` | A fee calculation requires a positive atomic collateral amount. |
| 1 | `EInvalidFeeBps` | A fee rate must be below the full basis-point denominator. |
| 2 | `EInvalidNav` | A priced operation requires positive shareholder NAV. |
| 3 | `EInvalidShareSupply` | A priced operation requires positive share supply. |
| 4 | `EInvalidShareAmount` | Presented shares must be positive and below the live supply. |
| 5 | `ENonpositiveContribution` | A mint requires a positive shareholder NAV contribution. |
| 6 | `EZeroSharesOut` | A positive credited contribution rounded down to zero shares. |
| 7 | `ENonpositiveGross` | Post-unwind NAV does not exceed the equity kept for remaining shares. |
| 8 | `EZeroNetPayout` | The redemption fee consumed the complete gross claim. |
| 9 | `EInvalidTargetLeverageBps` | A target leverage rate must be positive. |
| 10 | `EInvalidLotSize` | A venue lot size must be positive. |
| 11 | `EInvalidBase` | A proportional mint requires positive pre-mint absolute base. |
| 12 | `EOrderBelowMinLots` | A proportional mint or redemption order is below the required minimum lot multiple. |
| 13 | `ERedemptionUnderReduced` | The final absolute base exceeds the proportional remaining base. |
| 14 | `ERedemptionOverReduced` | The final absolute base is more than one lot below the proportional remaining base without reaching flat. |
| 15 | `EArithmeticOverflow` | An arithmetic result exceeds the supported u64 range. |
| 16 | `EMaintenanceReserveExceedsEquity` | The maintenance reserve exceeds the venue equity that backs it. |
| 17 | `EInvalidLifecycleTransition` | The lifecycle cannot make the requested transition. |
| 18 | `EOperationNotPermittedInLifecycle` | The lifecycle does not permit the requested operation. |
| 19 | `EMintBaseAboveBound` | The final absolute base exceeds the pre-mint base plus the planned proportional order. |
| 20 | `EMintBaseBelowBound` | The final absolute base is below the pre-mint base plus the proportional order funded by the actual credited contribution. |
| 21 | `EInvalidMinOrderLots` | A minimum lot multiple is invalid: policy requires 2 to 1,000,000; raw arithmetic requires a positive value. |
| 22 | `EInvalidRebalancePolicy` | Rebalance thresholds are not strictly ordered. |
| 23 | `EInvalidNavCap` | A NAV cap must be positive and admit a target notional at max leverage. |
| 24 | `EInvalidMaxPriceAge` | A price maximum age must be positive. |
| 25 | `EInvalidMaxConfidenceBps` | A confidence bound must be below the basis-point denominator. |
| 26 | `EInvalidMaxMarkDivergenceBps` | A mark-divergence bound must be below the basis-point denominator. |
| 27 | `EStalePrice` | A price is older than its freshness budget. |
| 28 | `EFuturePrice` | A price is too far ahead of the reference time. |
| 29 | `EInvalidPrice` | A price used for pricing or gating is zero. |
| 30 | `EConfidenceExceedsBound` | Confidence exceeds its relative bound. |
| 31 | `EMarkOracleDivergenceExceedsBound` | Venue mark diverges too far from its oracle. |
| 32 | `EInvalidMaxSlippageBps` | Strict max slippage must be below the basis-point denominator. |
| 33 | `EInvalidEmergencyMaxSlippageBps` | Emergency slippage must include max slippage and remain below the denominator. |
| 34 | `EInvalidMinLeverageImprovementBps` | Minimum leverage improvement must be positive. |
| 35 | `ESharesOutBelowMinimum` | A mint produced fewer shares than the caller's stated minimum. |
| 36 | `ENavCapExceeded` | Shareholder NAV exceeds the Vault NAV cap. |
| 37 | `EExecutionOutsideMaxSlippage` | An executed value diverges from its reference beyond the max slippage. |
| 38 | `EInvalidFreshnessWindow` | Forward clock skew must not exceed the staleness budget. |
| 39 | `EInvalidMaxOrderNotional` | The maximum order notional must be positive. |
| 40 | `EMaxOrderNotionalUnchanged` | A maximum-order-notional update repeated the current setting. |
| 41 | `EInvalidObservationLotSize` | A normalized position observation must use a positive venue lot size. |
| 42 | `EInvalidPositionObservation` | A normalized position must be flat or use positive, lot-aligned base and notional. |
| 43 | `EOrderNotionalExceedsMaximum` | An order exceeds the live per-order maximum notional. |
| 44 | `EInvalidInitializationObservation` | A seed observation's position side differs from the immutable product side. |
| 45 | `EInitializationLeverageUnhealthy` | Seed activation leverage lies outside the immutable healthy band. |
| 46 | `EInitializationBaseBelowMinOrder` | Seed activation position cannot support the immutable minimum operation. |
| 47 | `EFeeCapExceeded` | A live fee or allocation exceeds its immutable issuance ceiling. |
| 48 | `EFeeSettingsUnchanged` | A fee update must change at least one live setting. |
| 49 | `EMintOutsideRebalanceBand` | Leverage before or after a mint lies outside the rebalance band. |
| 50 | `EActiveCheckpointChanged` | The observation pair changed between plan and completion. |
| 51 | `EActiveFillIncomplete` | The venue fill does not match the planned base order. |
| 52 | `EActiveLeverageAboveCap` | Post-operation leverage exceeds the policy maximum. |
| 53 | `ERedemptionOutputBelowMinimum` | The redemption pays less than the holder's stated minimum. |
| 54 | `ERebalanceInsideBand` | An active rebalance was requested at or inside the one rebalance band. |
| 55 | `ERebalanceNoProgress` | No admissible whole-lot rebalance progress was completed. |
| 56 | `EVenueFeeUnusable` | A venue fee or execution bound cannot be represented conservatively. |
| 57 | `EInvalidAssetDecimals` | An asset precision exceeds the widest the notional formulas support. |
| 58 | `ENavCapUnchanged` | A NAV cap update must change the cap. |
| 59 | `EInvalidMaxReserveBps` | The reserve ceiling must be a positive share of notional, at most 100%. |
| 60 | `ESeedReserveAboveCap` | A seed reserve exceeds the policy ceiling for the opening notional. |
| 61 | `EInvariantViolated` | A mutation left the state in violation of an accounting invariant that must hold by construction. |
| 62 | `EInvalidTickSize` | A venue tick size must be positive to price a limit order. |
| 63 | `EOrderCapBelowMinimum` | The live order cap cannot fund the required minimum whole-lot order. |
| 64 | `EProfitRealizationNotNeeded` | No positive cash shortfall and realizable profit require maintenance. |
| 65 | `EProfitRealizationUneconomic` | Profit realization cannot justify its bounded trading cost. |
| 66 | `EInitialMarginHeadroom` | The live venue's initial-margin settings leave no conservative opening cushion. |
| 67 | `ERebalanceNotActionable` | No whole-lot increase can fit the permitted leverage range. |
| 68 | `ERebalanceOutsideBand` | The exceptional one-lot rebalance did not finish inside both band edges. |
| 69 | `ERebalanceCapacity` | The required improvement exceeds even a cost-free full rebalance at the NAV cap. |
| 70 | `ERebalanceOrderLimit` | A rebalance cannot accept more fills than its core-owned order budget. |

### `blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core`

Boosts administration roles in the shared Blast ACL, used by every leverage adapter.  A role is a type. An `AdminCap` holding `Role` signs in to `AdminWitness<Role>`, and a function's witness parameter names the one role it accepts, so a role from any other package is a different type and cannot reach these operations.  The core package is published immutably, so `UpgradeAdmin` governs adapter package custody rather than any transition in this package.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/blast_boosts_core.move

#### Types

```move
/// Issues an adapter Vault and its share currency, and updates that currency's metadata.
public struct VaultIssuer {}

/// Sets a Vault's fees, NAV cap and maximum order notional, and withdraws its admin fees.
public struct RiskAdmin {}

/// Irreversibly begins a Vault's shutdown.
public struct ShutdownAdmin {}

/// Authorizes and activates adapter upgrades, or permanently ends them.
public struct UpgradeAdmin {}
```

### `blast_boosts_core::constants`

Package-wide immutable core numeric constants.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `basis_points_denominator: u64 = 10_000`: Returns the denominator for one basis-point rate.
- `leverage_ceiling_bps: u64 = 100 * basis_points_denominator!()`: Structural ceiling on any leverage threshold: 100x in leverage basis points.  No leveraged coin in this protocol targets more than a small multiple, and the mint-contribution allowance scales with target leverage, so an unbounded threshold would let a transposed or mistyped policy admit almost any contribution. The ceiling is a sanity fence, not a selected product value.
- `max_min_order_lots: u64 = 1_000_000`: Structural ceiling on the minimum operation size in live venue lots.  The minimum exists so a small holder can still exit; a million lots can never be small in collateral terms. The fence also catches a policy that swaps `min_order_lots` with an atomic-collateral value such as the NAV cap, which would otherwise brick every mint of an immutable policy.
- `max_asset_decimals: u8 = 18`: Widest asset precision the notional formulas support without overflow.
- `max_rebalance_orders: u64 = 16`: One rebalance's bounded execution and capacity projection share this budget.
- `unwind_bound_widening_duration_ms: u64 = 86_400_000`: How long after shutdown begins the close-only execution bound takes to widen, linearly, from the ordinary bound to the emergency one: 24 hours.  A permissionless close must stay as cheap for holders as honest depth allows, yet a book that stays thin must not refuse the exit forever, so the admitted execution widens with time instead of opening at the wide bound.

### `blast_boosts_core::lifecycle`

Irreversible lifecycle and operation permissions for one Vault.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/lifecycle.move

#### Types

```move
/// A Vault is born active; only authenticated shutdown moves it forward.
public enum Lifecycle has drop, store {
    Active,
    /// Shutdown began at the recorded adapter clock time; the close-only
    /// execution bound widens from that instant.
    Unwinding {
        began_at_ms: u64,
    },
    Settled,
}

/// Administrator-declared operational reason, never an on-chain liquidation verdict.
public enum ShutdownReason has copy, drop {
    Emergency,
    ObservedVenueChange,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Declares an administrator's emergency decision, without an objective venue verdict.
public fun emergency_reason(): ShutdownReason

/// Declares an off-chain venue-change observation, including liquidation or ADL.
public fun observed_venue_change_reason(): ShutdownReason
```

### `blast_boosts_core::observation`

Operation-scoped observations supplied by a venue adapter.  These values prove neither source identity nor caller authority. The adapter authenticates its venue and oracle sources before it constructs them; the core reads them during the enclosing operation and never stores one.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/observation.move

#### Types

```move
/// One normalized price and its source confidence and publication time.
///
/// Constructors require a positive price for priced operations.
public struct PriceObservation has drop {
    price: u64,
    confidence: u64,
    publish_time_ms: u64,
}

/// The external facts one operation prices against: the venue position and
/// the oracle pair, as the adapter authenticated them.
///
/// The adapter authenticates venue state and applies opening-margin admission
/// only where the operation requires it; the core values what it is given.
public struct PositionObservation has drop {
    venue_equity: u64,
    /// Unsigned position size in base-asset atoms; direction is `observed_side`.
    position_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    observed_side: policy::PositionSide,
    base_oracle: PriceObservation,
    collateral_oracle: PriceObservation,
    mark_price: u64,
}

/// The normalized result of one isolated funding settlement.
public enum FundingSettlement has drop {
    Credit(u64),
    Cost(u64),
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Creates one positive normalized price observation.
public fun new_price(price: u64, confidence: u64, price_published_at_ms: u64): PriceObservation

/// Creates one position observation; base is whole lots and the mark is positive.
///
```
