```move
/// `observed_side` retains the venue's direction; it has no meaning while flat.
public fun new_position(
    venue_equity: u64,
    position_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    observed_side: policy::PositionSide,
    base_oracle: PriceObservation,
    collateral_oracle: PriceObservation,
    mark_price: u64,
): PositionObservation

/// Creates a credit funding outcome.
public fun funding_credit(amount: u64): FundingSettlement

/// Creates a cost funding outcome.
public fun funding_cost(amount: u64): FundingSettlement
```

### `blast_boosts_core::policy`

Immutable core policy values and pure policy gates.  This slice selects no production value, authenticates no price source, and owns no Vault or venue state.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Immutable venue position direction.
///
/// Contract code uses Long and Short. Bull and Bear remain display names only.
public enum PositionSide has copy, drop, store {
    Long,
    Short,
}

/// Immutable rebalance thresholds and execution constraints for one Vault.
///
/// Values use leverage basis points, where 10,000 means 1x. Construction
/// validates only relationships that are independent of simulation; this
/// module does not select production values.
public struct RebalancePolicy has copy, drop, store {
    rebalance_below_bps: u64,
    target_leverage_bps: u64,
    rebalance_above_bps: u64,
    max_leverage_bps: u64,
    max_slippage_bps: u64,
    emergency_max_slippage_bps: u64,
    min_leverage_improvement_bps: u64,
}

/// The execution bound one venue order is priced and proved under, in basis
/// points of the reference price: the limit the adapter places the order at
/// sits inside it, and the fill must land inside it.
///
/// Only this module constructs one, from the policy's own bounds, so no
/// caller of a permissionless operation can choose the price it accepts.
public struct ExecutionBound has copy, drop {
    slippage_bps: u64,
}

/// Locally validated bounds for the price gates of one Vault.
///
/// Millisecond bounds use the on-chain clock scale. Relative bounds use the
/// package's 10,000 basis-point denominator. A future core transition will
/// verify the bound oracle source directly; the adapter owns venue observations.
/// Freshness and confidence gate each share-pricing source; mark divergence gates venue
/// margin safety only and never supplies shareholder-NAV or accounting inputs.
/// Every bound is inclusive, freshness arithmetic branches to avoid underflow,
/// and relative comparisons cross-multiply through `u128`.
///
/// This value cannot prove that observations came from the bound source or one
/// operation-scoped price pair. Those remain core and adapter obligations.
public struct PricePolicy has copy, drop, store {
    max_price_age_ms: u64,
    max_price_ahead_ms: u64,
    max_confidence_bps: u64,
    max_mark_divergence_bps: u64,
}

/// The immutable rule-set one Vault is issued with.
///
/// Fee rates are the values the Vault starts with; the admin may move them
/// later inside the caps recorded here.
public struct VaultPolicy has copy, drop, store {
    side: PositionSide,
    rebalance_policy: RebalancePolicy,
    price_policy: PricePolicy,
    /// Fee rates the Vault starts with; `State` holds the live, adjustable rates.
    initial_mint_fee_bps: u64,
    initial_redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    mint_fee_cap_bps: u64,
    redeem_fee_cap_bps: u64,
    admin_share_cap_bps: u64,
    min_order_lots: u64,
    /// Ceiling on the maintenance reserve as basis points of position notional.
    max_reserve_bps: u64,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Returns the long position direction.
public fun long(): PositionSide

/// Returns the short position direction.
public fun short(): PositionSide

/// Creates one immutable rebalance policy from structurally valid values.
///
/// Thresholds must satisfy `rebalance_below < target < rebalance_above < max_leverage`,
/// and max leverage must not exceed the
/// structural `leverage_ceiling_bps` ceiling, which bounds every threshold below
/// it and so bounds the mint-contribution allowance. A zero rebalance-below
/// threshold is valid and means no caller may rebalance from below; leverage
/// can never be below zero, so the lower public trigger is then unreachable by
/// design. Max slippage must stay below 10,000 bps. Emergency max slippage
/// must be at least max slippage and below 10,000 bps. Minimum leverage improvement
/// must be positive.
public fun new_rebalance_policy(
    rebalance_below_bps: u64,
    target_leverage_bps: u64,
    rebalance_above_bps: u64,
    max_leverage_bps: u64,
    max_slippage_bps: u64,
    emergency_max_slippage_bps: u64,
    min_leverage_improvement_bps: u64,
): RebalancePolicy

/// Creates immutable price policy from proposed structural bounds.
///
/// `max_price_age_duration_ms` must be positive because the structural policy requires
/// a nonzero historical-age slippage. This check alone does not prove that a
/// selected value supports the deployed source cadence; that remains a live
/// integration and simulation gate. `max_price_ahead_duration_ms` may be zero; zero is
/// the strictest clock-skew policy and rejects the first millisecond after the
/// reference time. It must not exceed `max_price_age_duration_ms`: clock skew is never
/// larger than a staleness budget, and the rule catches a transposed pair
/// that would otherwise reject every aged update and admit future-dated ones.
///
/// Both relative bounds may be zero, which demands an exact price and an exact
/// mark, and both must stay below the 10,000 basis-point denominator. At or
/// above the denominator a confidence interval may span the complete price and
/// a divergence bound admits a zero mark, so the gate would stop constraining
/// the observation at all.
///
/// No upper millisecond bound is structural. The deployed source cadence,
/// keeper latency, venue margin parameters, and simulation select every value
/// here; this package compiles none of them and validates no value against
/// live venue state.
public fun new_price_policy(
    max_price_age_duration_ms: u64,
    max_price_ahead_duration_ms: u64,
    max_confidence_bps: u64,
    max_mark_divergence_bps: u64,
): PricePolicy

/// Composes one complete immutable policy for one future Vault.
///
/// The initial fee rates seed the live `State` rates; each stays at or below
/// its cap, and both caps stay below 10,000 bps. `admin_share_cap_bps` bounds
/// the share of future collected fees the admin may take and may equal
/// 10,000; the Vault starts with an admin share of zero.
/// `min_order_lots` is at least two and at most `max_min_order_lots`.
/// Two only excludes the vacuous one-lot rounding bound; each product still
/// needs a simulated minimum for its band, seed and intended growth.
/// `max_reserve_bps` is positive and at most 10,000: the maintenance reserve
/// may hold at most that share of position notional, and every reserve
/// credit is clamped to it so the excess stays with holders as NAV.
/// The NAV cap is not part of the policy: it is a live `State` value the
/// admin may move, supplied to `state::issue` directly.
public fun new_vault_policy(
    side: PositionSide,
    rebalance_policy: RebalancePolicy,
    price_policy: PricePolicy,
    initial_mint_fee_bps: u64,
    initial_redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    mint_fee_cap_bps: u64,
    redeem_fee_cap_bps: u64,
    admin_share_cap_bps: u64,
    min_order_lots: u64,
    max_reserve_bps: u64,
): VaultPolicy

/// The bound in basis points of the reference price.
public fun slippage_bps(self: &ExecutionBound): u64

/// The price limit an order under this bound is placed with: the reference
/// moved by the bound against the order, up for a bid and down for an ask,
/// then rounded to a multiple of `tick_size` back toward the reference.
///
/// The limit always stays inside the bound, so a venue that honors it cannot
/// fill outside the bound, and the fill proof against the same reference
/// cannot then fail on price. A tick wider than the bound leaves no such
/// price and aborts; a zero reference or tick aborts first.
public fun limit_price(
    self: &ExecutionBound,
    reference_price: u64,
    is_ask: bool,
    tick_size: u64,
): u64

/// Rejects a price outside this bound of the reference; a zero reference
/// price aborts first. Inclusive:
/// `|executed_price - reference_price| * 10_000 <= slippage_bps * reference_price`.
public fun assert_execution(self: &ExecutionBound, reference_price: u64, executed_price: u64)
```

### `blast_boosts_core::state`

Venue-neutral state for one core leveraged product.  The selected adapter stores this value inside its own shared Vault. Only functions in this module can inspect or change the private core fields. Currency, venue custody, ACL routing, and versioning belong to the adapter. The core reads no clock: every `now_ms` is the adapter's `Clock::timestamp_ms()` for the transaction, and oracle freshness is judged against it.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/core/sources/state.move

#### Types

```move
/// An issued product before its seed position exists: the immutable policy
/// and the two live knobs the issuer set.
///
/// The adapter opens the seed position under these terms, then `activate`
/// turns them and the seeded observation into the `State`. The value has no
/// abilities, so an issuance that is not activated cannot be stored: a
/// product is either live or never existed.
public struct Issuance<phantom Product> {
    vault_policy: policy::VaultPolicy,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    nav_cap: u64,
    /// `10^decimals` of the venue's base asset and of the bound collateral:
    /// facts about the assets, fixed here so the seed orders and the live
    /// state price base the same way.
    base_unit: u64,
    collateral_unit: u64,
}

/// Sealed core state stored inside one adapter-owned Vault.
///
/// The value can be stored but cannot be copied or dropped. `Product`
/// separates independent leveraged products at the type level.
public struct State<phantom Product> has store {
    vault_policy: policy::VaultPolicy,
    /// Largest atomic-collateral notional of one adapter order, adjustable by
    /// the selected risk module. Execution slippage is bounded separately by
    /// the immutable rebalance policy, so this value only paces orders.
    max_order_notional: u64,
    /// Collateral inside the venue account that share pricing excludes. Every
    /// credit is clamped to the policy ceiling for the live notional, so the
    /// reserve can never grow past the share of the position it protects.
    maintenance_reserve: u64,
    /// Funding cost holders bore while the reserve was exhausted; later credits
    /// repay it to NAV before any credit rebuilds the reserve.
    uncovered_deficit: u64,
    /// `10^decimals` of the venue's base asset, fixed at initialization.
    base_unit: u64,
    /// `10^decimals` of the bound collateral, fixed at initialization.
    collateral_unit: u64,
    lifecycle: lifecycle::Lifecycle,
    mint_fee_bps: u64,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    admin_share_bps: u64,
    /// Inclusive ceiling on post-mint shareholder NAV, adjustable by the admin.
    /// Only mints check it: NAV may exceed it through position profit, which
    /// just blocks further mints until NAV falls back under or the cap is raised.
    nav_cap: u64,
}

/// The position priced at one oracle pair: equity, base, base valued at the
/// pair, the lot, and the pair itself. Sealed into every plan and reported
/// back to the adapter; never persisted as a second ledger.
public struct ActivePosition has copy, drop {
    equity: u64,
    base: u64,
    notional: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    base_price: u64,
    collateral_price: u64,
}

/// Linear, transaction-local mint terms. Only State can construct or finish them.
public struct MintPlan<phantom Product> {
    before: ActivePosition,
    expected_contribution: u64,
    reserve_fee: u64,
    admin_fee: u64,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    minimum_shares: u64,
    base_to_buy: u64,
    /// Only a below-band position with no executable standalone increase qualifies.
    recovery: bool,
}

/// Linear terms for one proportional redemption, before any payout or fee credit.
public struct RedemptionPlan<phantom Product> {
    before: ActivePosition,
    shares_to_redeem: u64,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    minimum_collateral_out: u64,
    fee_bps: u64,
    admin_share_bps: u64,
    base_to_sell: u64,
}

/// Linear maintenance intent, advanced only by accepted fixed-pair fills.
public struct RebalancePlan<phantom Product> {
    before: ActivePosition,
    current: ActivePosition,
    /// The reserve as the ceiling admits it against `before`; every NAV in the plan uses it.
    reserve_priced: u64,
    increase: bool,
    /// Whether the plan began above the hard cap and so may use the emergency
    /// execution bound. Such a reduction sells only what restores the cap and
    /// stops there: below the cap only the ordinary bound applies, and a
    /// market that cannot fill within it must not revert the progress made.
    emergency: bool,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
    steps: u64,
    /// Every reduction fill matched both its order and fresh core sizing.
    full_fills: bool,
}

/// The next whole-lot order a rebalance places: its size, direction, whether
/// the position is still above the hard cap, and the execution bound it is
/// priced and proved under. A zero size ends the plan.
public struct RebalanceOrder has drop {
    base: u64,
    increase: bool,
    emergency: bool,
    bound: policy::ExecutionBound,
    /// A single lot may cross target only when it lands inside the full band.
    band_landing: bool,
}

/// Linear terms for one bounded close-and-reopen that realizes existing profit.
/// The final base must equal the starting base; all trading costs remain in NAV.
public struct ProfitRealizationPlan<phantom Product> {
    before: ActivePosition,
    base_to_realize: u64,
    max_cost: u64,
    reserve_priced: u64,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Issues one product. The caller signs in as a Vault issuer; `nav_cap` must
/// satisfy `RebalancePolicy::assert_nav_cap_valid` and stays adjustable through
/// `set_nav_cap`. The asset decimals fix the units every base valuation of this
/// product uses.
public fun issue<Product>(
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::VaultIssuer>,
    vault_policy: policy::VaultPolicy,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    nav_cap: u64,
    base_decimals: u8,
    collateral_decimals: u8,
): Issuance<Product>

/// Checks live venue rates against this issuance's immutable execution and
/// leverage policy. The adapter rounds each nonnegative rate upward to bps.
public fun assert_initial_margin_headroom<Product>(
    self: &Issuance<Product>,
    initial_margin_bps: u64,
    collateral_haircut_bps: u64,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
)

/// Sizes the opening position from a flat seed observation: the whole-lot
/// target base, the whole-lot base one order may carry, and the priced flat
/// seed whose pair and lot the orders are placed under.
///
/// Sizing only. Every guard runs in `activate` against the position actually
/// filled, in the same transaction; a copy here could not refuse a state that
/// `activate` admits.
public fun seed_terms<Product>(
    self: &Issuance<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    seed_reserve: u64,
): (u64, u64, ActivePosition)

/// Turns the issuance and the observation the adapter took after the seed
/// position opened into the live state.
///
/// Returns the state, the seed's reserve-excluded shareholder NAV in atomic
/// collateral units, and the priced seed position. Every price, capacity,
/// leverage and minimum-order guard runs before the state exists.
public fun activate<Product>(
    self: Issuance<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    seed_reserve: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): (State<Product>, u64, ActivePosition)

/// The immutable direction every seed order takes.
public fun seed_side<Product>(self: &Issuance<Product>): policy::PositionSide

/// Rejects one seed order above the per-order notional cap.
public fun assert_seed_order_notional_allowed<Product>(
    self: &Issuance<Product>,
    order_notional: u64,
)

/// The bound every seed order is priced and proved under: the ordinary one,
/// because opening a position always increases risk.
public fun seed_execution_bound<Product>(self: &Issuance<Product>): policy::ExecutionBound

/// The immutable direction every order of this product takes.
public fun side<Product>(self: &State<Product>): policy::PositionSide

/// Whole-lot capacity under the ordinary execution bound. Closing orders may
/// use exactly one venue lot when the configured cap cannot cover one lot.
public fun max_order_base<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    position: &ActivePosition,
    reduce_only: bool,
): u64

/// Checks the actual filled quote against the cap. The adapter must prove
/// the fill is reduce-only and exactly one live venue lot for the sole
/// exception; the same execution-price bound still applies to that fill.
public fun assert_order_notional_allowed<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    order_notional: u64,
    filled_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    reduce_only: bool,
)

/// The bound every mint, redemption and ordinary rebalance order is priced and
/// proved under. A rebalance order carries its own bound, which is the wider
/// emergency one only while the position is above the hard cap, and a
/// close-only order takes the bound `unwind_constraints` prices at.
public fun execution_bound<Product>(self: &State<Product>): policy::ExecutionBound

/// Seals proportional exposure, or deposit-funded catch-up for untradeable lot dust.
/// The adapter authenticates the observation, supply and ordinary taker fee.
/// Both paths must complete inside the band; the user's share floor is unchanged.
public fun prepare_mint<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    collateral_deposit: u64,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    minimum_shares: u64,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): MintPlan<Product>

/// Returns the entire required whole-lot increase, not caller-selected sizing.
public fun base_to_buy<Product>(self: &MintPlan<Product>): u64

/// Returns the admin cash the adapter must retain before depositing collateral.
public fun admin_fee<Product>(self: &MintPlan<Product>): u64

/// Returns the sealed input for completed adapter accounting facts.
/// The position the mint was priced against; the adapter trades at its pair and lot.
public fun mint_position<Product>(self: &MintPlan<Product>): ActivePosition

/// Completes the sealed proportional or recovery fill and credits its reserve allocation.
/// The credited contribution is capped at the deposit net of the whole fee, so
/// a favorable fill accrues to existing holders (ADR 0084 D3).
/// The returned shares are minted through the adapter's native share authority.
/// The actual final position must remain inside both inclusive band edges.
/// Returns shares, contribution, fee, admin, reserve and the two sealed rates.
public fun complete_mint<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    plan: MintPlan<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): (u64, u64, u64, u64, u64)

/// Seals a rounded-up attributable close and the redeemer's output floor.
public fun prepare_redemption<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    shares_to_redeem: u64,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    minimum_collateral_out: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): RedemptionPlan<Product>

/// Returns the full reduce-only order amount; flat redemptions require no order.
public fun base_to_sell<Product>(self: &RedemptionPlan<Product>): u64

/// The position the redemption was priced against.
public fun redemption_position<Product>(self: &RedemptionPlan<Product>): ActivePosition

/// Shares the redeemer must burn.
public fun redemption_shares<Product>(self: &RedemptionPlan<Product>): u64

/// Computes the payout after the sell and credits the fee once, excluding admin cash.
/// The gross is capped at the proportional claim, so a favorable sell accrues
/// to the remaining holders (ADR 0084 D3).
/// Returns the user payout, the admin cash, the fee, and the fee's reserve share.
/// The adapter withdraws exactly payout plus admin cash and proves that on the checkpoint.
public fun complete_redemption<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    plan: RedemptionPlan<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): (u64, u64, u64, u64)

/// Core-owned bound shared by the adapter's loop and the progress projection.
public fun max_rebalance_orders(): u64

/// Whether the position needs a reduction, or a nonzero increase the adapter permits.
/// `increases_allowed` only filters this read-only keeper hint; real execution
/// still prepares a linear plan and rechecks the venue's opening admission.
/// Increase sizing uses the same authenticated fee as execution; lot dust returns false.
public fun needs_rebalance<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    increases_allowed: bool,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): bool

/// Derives public maintenance intent from exact outside-band ratios, never caller orders.
public fun prepare_rebalance<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): RebalancePlan<Product>

/// The next order toward the band, sized from the position the last fill left.
///
/// A zero size ends the plan; core and adapter share the core-owned order budget. An
/// emergency reduction sells only what brings leverage back to the hard cap
/// and ends as soon as it is no longer above it, so the emergency bound never
/// covers more notional than restoring the cap needs, never an order placed
/// below the cap, and a wide market cannot revert the orders placed above it.
public fun next_rebalance_order<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    plan: &RebalancePlan<Product>,
): RebalanceOrder

/// The position the rebalance was priced against.
public fun rebalance_position<Product>(self: &RebalancePlan<Product>): ActivePosition

/// Whether the plan buys toward the target rather than sells.
public fun is_increasing<Product>(self: &RebalancePlan<Product>): bool

/// Whether the authenticated starting position was strictly above the hard cap.
/// Fixed for the plan: its own fills cannot promote ordinary maintenance.
public fun is_emergency_rebalance<Product>(self: &RebalancePlan<Product>): bool

public fun order_base(self: &RebalanceOrder): u64

public fun is_increase(self: &RebalanceOrder): bool

public fun is_emergency(self: &RebalanceOrder): bool

/// The bound the order is priced and proved under.
public fun bound(self: &RebalanceOrder): policy::ExecutionBound

/// Advances the plan by one accepted whole-lot fill of `order` under the fixed oracle pair.
public fun accept_rebalance_fill<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    plan: &mut RebalancePlan<Product>,
    order: RebalanceOrder,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    filled_base: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
)

/// Completes holder-funded maintenance without changing reserve, supply or admin cash.
/// Returns authenticated before/after equity and base for one completed event.
public fun complete_rebalance<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    plan: RebalancePlan<Product>,
): (u64, u64, u64, u64, bool)

/// Sizes a whole-lot recovery of an adapter-authenticated cash shortfall and
/// an economical rounding minimum, capped to one opening-sized order. Larger deficits need further
/// transactions. No caller selects the size, price bound or cost allowance.
public fun prepare_profit_realization<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    cash_shortfall: u64,
    unrealized_profit: u64,
    venue_fee_bps: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): ProfitRealizationPlan<Product>

/// The fixed oracle pair and starting position used by both recovery orders.
public fun realization_position<Product>(self: &ProfitRealizationPlan<Product>): ActivePosition

/// Exact base to close and reopen in the same transaction.
public fun base_to_realize<Product>(self: &ProfitRealizationPlan<Product>): u64

/// Proves unchanged exposure, bounded actual cost and a healthy final position.
/// Does not change supply, reserve, funding deficit, fees or lifecycle.
public fun complete_profit_realization<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    plan: ProfitRealizationPlan<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): (u64, u64, u64, u64)

/// Applies one adapter-authenticated funding classification to the reserve.
///
/// Returns `(absorbed_by_reserve, uncovered_cost, restored_to_holders)` in
/// atomic collateral units. A cost consumes the reserve first; what it cannot
/// cover is borne by holder NAV and recorded as the uncovered deficit. A credit
/// repays that deficit first, by staying in NAV, and only its remainder
/// rebuilds the reserve. The adapter owns exact-once funding checkpoint
/// authentication; the core stores no venue cursor and never infers funding
/// from an equity change.
public fun settle_funding<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    settlement: observation::FundingSettlement,
): (u64, u64, u64)

/// Credits an exact donation to the reserve, clamped to the ceiling, without
/// creating supply or an admin entitlement. The adapter proves the venue took
/// exactly `amount` on the raw checkpoint; the core prices the position it left.
public fun donate<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    amount: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
)

/// Rejects an ordinary operation outside Active, before the adapter touches the venue.
public fun assert_active<Product>(self: &State<Product>)

/// Checks a recovery observation against the same prices, side and positive
/// shareholder NAV required by ordinary operations. Recovery changes no core
/// allocation: the authenticated venue loss is reflected in the next valuation.
public fun assert_recoverable_position<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    observation: observation::PositionObservation,
    now_at_ms: u64,
)

/// Rejects venue synchronization after the local cash pool has been sealed.
public fun assert_can_sync<Product>(self: &State<Product>)

/// Irreversibly stops ordinary operations. The owning adapter authenticates shutdown authority.
/// Moves the Vault to Unwinding at the adapter's clock reading `now_at_ms`,
/// from which the close-only execution bound widens.
public fun begin_shutdown<Product>(self: &mut State<Product>, now_at_ms: u64)

/// Authorizes only close-only venue progress before finalization.
public fun assert_unwinding<Product>(self: &State<Product>)

/// Prices a close-only order, sizes the per-order cap in whole lots at that
/// price, and fixes the execution bound every close order of this step is
/// priced and proved under: the ordinary bound when shutdown has just begun,
/// widening with the time since to the emergency bound. Insolvency and the
/// reserve do not gate an exit.
public fun unwind_constraints<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    base_oracle: observation::PriceObservation,
    collateral_oracle: observation::PriceObservation,
    lot_size: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): (policy::PositionSide, u64, u64, u64, policy::ExecutionBound)

/// Consumes the reserve book entry only after the adapter proves complete local cash recovery.
public fun finalize_shutdown<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    locked_shares: u64,
): u64

/// Rejects terminal claims before any adapter cash-field access.
public fun assert_settled<Product>(self: &State<Product>)

/// Fee-free claim against current cash and total share supply, excluding the immutable seed.
public fun shutdown_claim_quote<Product>(
    self: &State<Product>,
    recovered_cash: u64,
    total_share_supply: u64,
    locked_shares: u64,
    shares_to_claim: u64,
    minimum_collateral_out: u64,
): u64

/// Updates future fee collections under immutable issuance caps.
/// Adapter custody owns authentication; no assets or past allocations move.
public fun set_fees<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    mint_fee_bps: u64,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    admin_share_bps: u64,
): (u64, u64, u64)

/// Checks locally decidable cap inputs before an adapter reads external prices.
public fun assert_max_order_notional_update<Product>(self: &State<Product>, max_order_notional: u64)

/// Updates the live per-order notional cap.
///
/// The cap uses collateral atoms and does not limit total open exposure.
/// An exact one-lot reduce-only fill may exceed it; price checks still apply.
/// Adapter custody of `State<Product>` determines who can present mutable
/// access. The adapter must authenticate its currently selected risk module
/// before calling this function. Updates are available in every lifecycle
/// state because they change only the size of later calls, not the live position.
public fun set_max_order_notional<Product>(
    self: &mut State<Product>,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    base_oracle: observation::PriceObservation,
    collateral_oracle: observation::PriceObservation,
    lot_size: u64,
    now_at_ms: u64,
): u64

/// Replaces the NAV cap and returns the previous one.
///
/// Adapter custody owns authentication. The new cap must satisfy the same
/// bound issuance applies; it may be lowered below the current NAV, which
/// only blocks further mints.
public fun set_nav_cap<Product>(self: &mut State<Product>, nav_cap: u64): u64

/// Returns the authoritative funding-only maintenance reserve.
///
/// Adapter operations use this value only for replay-complete post-state
/// events. Reserve mutation remains exclusive to core transitions.
public fun maintenance_reserve<Product>(self: &State<Product>): u64

public fun equity(self: &ActivePosition): u64

public fun base(self: &ActivePosition): u64

public fun notional(self: &ActivePosition): u64

public fun lot_size(self: &ActivePosition): u64

public fun base_price(self: &ActivePosition): u64

public fun collateral_price(self: &ActivePosition): u64
```

## API reference: `blast_boosts_products` (Boost product tags)

Live on mainnet, published from an earlier revision. The source documented here has changed since; until it is republished, confirm signatures against the live package.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

### `blast_boosts_products::blast_boosts_products`

Blast-owned product tags for Series1 Boost currencies.  A Boost currency is `blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>` in the issuing adapter, and its `Product` argument is what a holder reads inside the coin type. Declaring every tag in this module keeps that inner type under the Blast name: `blast_boosts_products::NVDA_BULL_2X`.  Each product is one empty struct with no abilities named `<TICKER>_<SIDE>_<LEVERAGE>`, for example `public struct NVDA_BULL_2X {}`. `BULL` tracks the perp long and `BEAR` the inverse; the ticker is the Aftermath base asset without its USD suffix. A tag carries no authority and no state: Coin Registry admits one currency per tag type, and the Series1 issuer role is the only authority that can issue it. Adding a tag is a compatible upgrade of this package; nothing here is ever removed. A declared tag is not a live product until an adapter issues its currency.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/products/sources/blast_boosts_products.move

#### Types

## API reference: `blast_boosts_aftermath` (Boosts Aftermath adapter)

Not yet published on mainnet. Its interface may change before publication.

Events: every payload is emitted inside `blast_boosts_aftermath::blast_events::Event<T>`; filter on that type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EInvalidPackagePublisher` | A Publisher was not claimed by the canonical adapter module. |
| 1 | `EInvalidProductWitnessType` | A product witness is primitive and cannot identify a sealed product module. |
| 2 | `EAdminCapAccountMismatch` | An Aftermath admin capability is bound to another account object. |
| 3 | `EAccountObjectMismatch` | An Aftermath account object does not match the immutable binding. |
| 4 | `EAccountNumberMismatch` | An Aftermath account number does not match the immutable binding. |
| 5 | `ERegistryMismatch` | An Aftermath Registry does not match the immutable binding. |
| 6 | `EClearingHouseMismatch` | An Aftermath ClearingHouse does not match the immutable binding. |
| 7 | `EBaseOracleMismatch` | A base price-feed storage is not the one the bound market prices with. |
| 8 | `ECollateralOracleMismatch` | A collateral price-feed storage is not the one the bound market prices with. |
| 9 | `EOracleObservationMismatch` | The venue's named price is not the bound feed's price. |
| 10 | `ENormalizationOverflow` | A normalized venue value cannot fit its declared atomic unit. |
| 11 | `EInvalidCollateralDecimals` | Initialization collateral, and the market's collateral scale, must be six atomic decimals. |
| 12 | `EInvalidSeed` | Initialization seed collateral must be positive. |
| 13 | `EInvalidSeedReserve` | The maintenance reserve must leave positive seed shareholder NAV. |
| 14 | `EInvalidInitializationOrderSize` | The target or order cap cannot fund one complete base lot. |
| 15 | `EInitializationFillMismatch` | Initialization did not fill the exact planned base on the required side. |
| 16 | `EInitializationImrMismatch` | The selected IMR is outside (0, 1], below the live market floor, or differs after seeding. |
| 17 | `ELockedSharesOverflow` | Scaling seed NAV into nine-decimal locked shares overflowed `u64`. |
| 18 | `EInitializationOrderCountExceeded` | Atomic initialization requires more venue orders than the adapter permits. |
| 19 | `EZeroAmount` | A collateral input or withdrawal must be positive. |
| 20 | `EInsufficientAdminCash` | Earned local admin collateral cannot cover this withdrawal. |
| 21 | `ECashCheckpointMismatch` | A cash operation changed more or less than its exact authenticated collateral delta. |
| 22 | `EFillMismatch` | A market session failed to make a positive whole-lot fill on the selected side. |
| 23 | `EOrdersPosted` | A market session left posted orders. |
| 24 | `ELiquidation` | A market session reported liquidation or bad debt. |
| 25 | `EActiveOrderCountExceeded` | The active atomic operation exhausted its market-session bound. |
| 26 | `EDeadlineExpired` | The caller's deadline has passed. |
| 27 | `EActiveCheckpointMismatch` | An active venue session changed a field outside its authenticated execution. |
| 28 | `ERedemptionShareMismatch` | The held native share coin differs from the sealed redemption amount. |
| 29 | `EVenueFeeUnusable` | The nonnegative venue fee (including a priority surcharge when budgeted) exceeds one. |
| 30 | `EUnresolvedCheckpoint` | A financial operation observed a venue change not reconciled into the accepted checkpoint. |
| 31 | `ETerminalVenueUnsettled` | Terminal recovery requires exact flat exposure, settled liabilities and integral cash. |
| 32 | `EInvalidUnwindExposure` | A close requires positive exact whole-lot base in the bound product direction. |
| 33 | `EVenueNotReady` | The venue cannot serve the operation: open orders, unsafe margin, a paused market, or a frozen clearing house. |
| 34 | `EMetadataUnchanged` | A metadata update must change the name, the description, or the icon. |
| 35 | `EPriorityGasPrice` | An ordinary rebalance paid a gas price above the reference gas price. |
| 36 | `EPartnerNotAccepted` | Boosts does not accept this partner: Blast never added it, or its removal took effect. |
| 37 | `EPartnerUnchanged` | Adding or removing a partner must change the list: it is already accepted, or already being removed. |
| 38 | `EInvalidRebaseline` | Recovery requires a settled same-side reduction with no unexplained cash or order changes. |
| 39 | `ERedemptionExceedsReleasable` | The exact redemption payout exceeds cash the venue can release. |
| 40 | `EProfitRealizationNoProgress` | Profit realization did not improve cash availability enough to cover its cost. |

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::blast_boost`

The share currency type of every Boost this adapter issues.  Wallets, explorers, and indexers identify a coin by its type argument, so `Coin<BlastBoost<Product>>` is the name a holder reads. The shared `vault::Vault<Product>` custodies the product; it is not the currency.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/blast_boost.move

#### Types

```move
/// Currency marker for one Boost's share coin.
///
/// No value of this type is ever constructed. It carries `key` only because
/// Coin Registry admits a non-OTW currency solely on a `key` type defined by
/// the registering module, and it names the product so the currency reads as
/// a Blast Boost on every surface that shows the type.
public struct BlastBoost<phantom Product> has key {
    id: UID,
}
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::blast_boosts_aftermath`

Canonical package marker for this adapter, its operational generation, and the partners Boosts accepts.  The generation value, its checked arithmetic, and its replay event belong to `blast_admin::operational_version`; `init` seeds the value from the one-time witness before claiming the Publisher with it, so no other package can create this adapter's generation. This module owns the shared container, the compiled generation that identifies this bytecode, and the list of accepted Blast partners, one dynamic field per partner so the container's layout never changes.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/blast_boosts_aftermath.move

#### Types

```move
/// One-time witness: it seeds the adapter generation and claims this package's Publisher.
public struct BLAST_BOOSTS_AFTERMATH() has drop;

/// Shared operational generation for the Aftermath adapter package.
public struct Protocol has key {
    id: UID,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_BOOSTS_AFTERMATH>,
}

/// Dynamic-field key of a Blast partner Boosts accepts. Its value is the time
/// the partner stops being accepted: `u64::MAX` until Blast removes it.
public struct PartnerKey(ID) has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: Current adapter generation accepted by every protected mutation.

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::blast_events`

Stable event envelope for the Aftermath adapter package.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/lib/blast_events.move

#### Types

```move
/// Stable package-wide envelope for every adapter event payload.
public struct Event<T: copy + drop>(T) has copy, drop;
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::checkpoint`

The raw venue checkpoint the adapter proves every venue mutation against: how one is read, what may change between two, and what each operation must leave behind.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/checkpoint.move

#### Types

```move
/// Raw Aftermath state captured at one authenticated mutation boundary.
public struct Checkpoint has copy, drop, store {
    free_collateral: u64,
    allocated_collateral: u256,
    signed_base: u256,
    signed_quote_notional: u256,
    funding_snapshot_long: u256,
    funding_snapshot_short: u256,
    market_funding_long: u256,
    market_funding_short: u256,
    lot_size: u64,
    pending_ask_base: u256,
    pending_bid_base: u256,
    pending_order_count: u64,
    market_pause_mode: u8,
    market_frozen: bool,
    position_initial_margin_ratio: u256,
    market_initial_margin_ratio: u256,
    market_maintenance_margin_ratio: u256,
}

/// What moved between the checkpoint last accepted and the one just captured:
/// nothing, one funding settlement carrying its raw signed collateral delta, or
/// anything else, which no priced operation may build on and which shutdown
/// adopts only after reporting it.
public enum CheckpointChange has drop {
    Unchanged,
    FundingCredit(u256),
    FundingCost(u256),
    Unexpected,
}
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::constants`

Package-wide immutable adapter constants.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `share_decimals: u8 = 9`: Fixed decimals for every Boost currency issued by this adapter.
- `base_decimals: u8 = 9`: Decimals this adapter normalizes every venue base amount to.
- `collateral_decimals: u8 = 6`: Decimals of the only collateral this adapter admits.
- `ifixed_one: u256 = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000`: One in IFixed: `10^18`.
- `ifixed_per_basis_point: u256 = 100_000_000_000_000`: One basis point in IFixed: `10^18 / 10_000`.
- `base_atom_to_ifixed_scale: u256 = 1_000_000_000`: Raw IFixed units in one base atom: `10^(18 - 9)`.
- `collateral_atom_to_ifixed_scale: u256 = 1_000_000_000_000`: Raw IFixed units in one collateral atom: `10^(18 - 6)`.
- `collateral_to_base_scale: u256 = 1_000`: Base atoms per collateral atom at a unit price: `10^(9 - 6)`.
- `max_initialization_orders: u64 = 16`: Maximum market-order calls permitted in one atomic initialization session.
- `max_active_orders: u64 = 16`: Hard ceiling on venue market calls in one active atomic operation.
- `immediate_or_cancel_order_type: u64 = 3`: Aftermath's immediate-or-cancel order type for `clearing_house::place_limit_order`.  The deployed `execute_limit_order` (`0x3ec740df…`, interface revision `f62e74a`) admits types 0 to 3: 0 posts the unfilled remainder, 1 aborts unless the whole size fills, 2 aborts on any fill, and 3 fills what rests at or inside the limit and drops the rest without posting. Every order the adapter places is the last kind, so a session never leaves a resting order and a thin book fills less rather than worse.

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::events`

Replay-complete Aftermath adapter events.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/events.move

#### Events

```move
/// Emitted when one leverage currency is issued, before its Vault exists; the
/// `Product` type names the currency for good and `VaultInitialized` follows in
/// the same transaction with the Vault id.
public struct VaultIssued<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    treasury_cap_id: ID,
    metadata_cap_id: ID,
    vault_policy: blast_boosts_core::policy::VaultPolicy,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    nav_cap: u64,
}

/// Emitted after one atomic seed activates a bound Aftermath Vault.
public struct VaultInitialized<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    binding: venue_account::Binding,
    seed_amount: u64,
    seed_venue_equity: u64,
    seed_reserve: u64,
    seed_shareholder_nav: u64,
    locked_shares: u64,
    position_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    position_side: blast_boosts_core::policy::PositionSide,
    position_imr: u256,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Emitted once per venue order the adapter places, seed orders included,
/// after the fill passed the cap and execution-bound checks. The account is
/// the bound venue account (`VaultInitialized.binding` maps it to the Vault);
/// seed orders run before the Vault id exists. Prices are 9-decimal: the
/// oracle reference the order was priced from, the limit it was placed with,
/// which sits inside the bound that applied, and the average it filled at.
/// The quote is the raw IFixed amount the session moved.
public struct OrderFilled<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    account_object_id: ID,
    is_ask: bool,
    reduce_only: bool,
    requested_base: u64,
    filled_base: u64,
    filled_quote: u256,
    reference_price: u64,
    limit_price: u64,
    executed_price: u64,
}

/// Emitted after an active mint, including its actual contribution and both fee allocations.
public struct Minted<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    deposit: u64,
    shares: u64,
    contribution: u64,
    fee: u64,
    admin_fee: u64,
    reserve_fee: u64,
    reserve_after: u64,
    admin_cash_after: u64,
    supply_after: u64,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Completed native share burn and exact collateral payout after attributable unwind.
public struct Redeemed<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    shares: u64,
    net: u64,
    fee: u64,
    admin_fee: u64,
    reserve_fee: u64,
    reserve_after: u64,
    admin_cash_after: u64,
    supply_after: u64,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Emitted after a mint or redeem that named a partner, including a partner
/// paid nothing because its share is zero or not yet in force. It follows that
/// operation's `Minted` or `Redeemed` in the same transaction, whose
/// `admin_cash_after` still includes `partner_fee`: Blast's admin cash is that
/// minus `partner_fee`. `partner_fee` left `admin_fee`, the admin fee the
/// operation retained.
public struct PartnerFeePaid<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    partner_id: ID,
    admin_fee: u64,
    partner_fee: u64,
}

/// Blast added a partner to the ones Boosts accepts, at once, or cancelled its
/// pending removal.
public struct PartnerAdded has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
}

/// Blast removed a partner: Boosts accepts it until `accepted_until_ms`, after
/// which a mint or redeem that names it aborts.
public struct PartnerRemoved has copy, drop {
    partner_id: ID,
    accepted_until_ms: u64,
}

/// Completed maintenance with actual equity/exposure effects and unchanged allocations.
public struct Rebalanced<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    equity_before: u64,
    equity_after: u64,
    base_before: u64,
    base_after: u64,
    increase: bool,
    reserve_after: u64,
    admin_cash_after: u64,
    supply_after: u64,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// A completed close-and-reopen improved cash availability. Supply, reserve,
/// admin cash and position base are unchanged; actual trading costs stay in NAV.
public struct ProfitRealized<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    equity_before: u64,
    equity_after: u64,
    base_realized: u64,
    shortfall_before: u64,
    shortfall_after: u64,
    previous_checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Emitted after one nonzero isolated funding change is reconciled.
public struct FundingSettled<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    is_cost: bool,
    raw_amount: u256,
    amount: u64,
    absorbed_by_reserve: u64,
    uncovered_cost: u64,
    restored_to_holders: u64,
    reserve_after: u64,
    previous_checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// A sync found the venue in a state no vault operation explains. The accepted
/// checkpoint stands and priced operations are refused until a later sync
/// finds the venue explainable again or RiskAdmin rebaselines a reviewed forced
/// reduction; every such sync emits this event. An
/// unwind step that finds such a venue emits it too, then adopts the live
/// state and closes what the venue holds.
public struct CheckpointDrifted<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// RiskAdmin accepted a reviewed reduction. This records the historical edge
/// up to the pre-funding capture; a following FundingSettled records any local
/// settlement. Together they expose the final checkpoint and reserve. Native
/// metadata identifies the administrator; supply and admin cash do not move.
public struct CheckpointRebaselined<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    previous_checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Completed venue cash deposit allocated entirely to the funding buffer.
public struct Donated<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    amount: u64,
    reserve_after: u64,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
}

/// Emitted after shutdown-role authorization permanently stops ordinary operations.
public struct ShutdownBegun<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    reason: blast_boosts_core::lifecycle::ShutdownReason,
}

/// Completed close-only progress with exact raw venue effects: the checkpoint
/// the step adopted after reconciling the stored one, the checkpoint the close
/// left, the orders placed and the quote they filled. The venue's
/// settlement of a closed market places no order and fills no quote.
public struct UnwindProgress<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    before: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    after: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    market_orders: u64,
    filled_quote: Option<u256>,
}

/// Actual recovered holder cash and fixed eligible supply after venue finality.
public struct ShutdownFinalized<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    recovered_cash: u64,
    eligible_supply: u64,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    unrecoverable_collateral_raw: u256,
}

/// Completed native share burn and fee-free local collateral payout.
public struct ShutdownRedeemed<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    shares: u64,
    cash_paid: u64,
    cash_remaining: u64,
    eligible_remaining: u64,
}

/// Completed live-setting update; immutable caps and existing balances do not change.
public struct FeesUpdated<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    previous_mint_bps: u64,
    previous_redeem_bps: u64,
    previous_admin_bps: u64,
    mint_bps: u64,
    redeem_bps: u64,
    admin_share_bps: u64,
}

/// Completed NAV cap update; existing NAV and balances do not change.
public struct NavCapUpdated<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    previous_nav_cap: u64,
    nav_cap: u64,
}

/// Emitted after the active risk module changes the live maximum order notional.
public struct MaxOrderNotionalUpdated<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    previous: u64,
    max_order_notional: u64,
}

/// Completed Coin Registry metadata update; the symbol and supply are untouched.
public struct MetadataUpdated<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    icon_url: String,
}

/// Completed withdrawal from native admin cash; no holder or buffer claim is created.
public struct AdminFeesWithdrawn<phantom Product> has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    amount: u64,
    remaining: u64,
}
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::operations`

Atomic Aftermath operations for adapter-owned leverage Vaults.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/operations.move

#### Functions

```move
/// Seeds one issuance and returns its activated Vault and ClearingHouse.
/// The same transaction must share both after composition.
///
/// Direction and size come only from the immutable core policy; the caller
/// chooses no order parameter.
/// Every external value is retained in the Vault, shared, consumed, or returned.
/// Only the issuer's transaction can reach this: the issuance has no abilities,
/// so it cannot be stored, shared, or handed to another signer.
public fun initialize<Product, Collateral>(
    issuance: vault::VaultIssuance<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    currency: &Currency<Collateral>,
    registry: &mut registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    seed: Coin<Collateral>,
    seed_reserve: u64,
    position_imr: u256,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>, clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>)

/// Exchanges exact bound collateral for native leverage shares in one atomic operation.
/// Policy fixes direction and whole-lot size; partial sessions must complete the aggregate.
/// Returns the ClearingHouse for composition; the transaction must share it afterward.
public fun mint<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    cash: Coin<Collateral>,
    minimum_shares: u64,
    deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>, clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>)

/// Burns native shares only after their proportional close and exact collateral payout.
/// Entry-quote and realized PnL use authenticated post-session state, never an invented formula.
/// Returns the ClearingHouse for composition; the transaction must share it afterward.
public fun redeem<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    shares: Coin<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
    minimum_collateral: u64,
    deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Collateral>, clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>)

/// Adds `partner` to the Blast partners Boosts accepts, at once. Adding a
/// partner whose removal is pending cancels the removal.
public fun add_partner(
    protocol: &mut blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
)

/// Removes `partner` from the Blast partners Boosts accepts, with the same
/// notice Blast gives for every change to a partner: it stays accepted, and
/// paid, for `blast_partners::delay_ms()`.
public fun remove_partner(
    protocol: &mut blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// `mint`, naming a Blast partner Boosts accepts: the partner is paid its share
/// of the admin fee this mint retained. Holders' shares and the reserve are
/// exactly `mint`'s.
public fun mint_with_partner<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    cash: Coin<Collateral>,
    minimum_shares: u64,
    deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>, clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>)

/// `redeem`, naming a Blast partner Boosts accepts: the partner is paid its
/// share of the admin fee this redemption retained. The redeemer's payout is
/// exactly `redeem`'s.
public fun redeem_with_partner<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    shares: Coin<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
    minimum_collateral: u64,
    deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Collateral>, clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>)

/// A keeper hint: true for a needed reduction, or an increase with opening margin.
/// Inside the band, without opening margin, or for an unsizeable increase, returns false.
/// Unexplained checkpoint drift, invalid prices or an unavailable venue abort.
/// Intended for dev-inspect: fee-aware sizing is shared with execution, but
/// funding, gas admission, liquidity and fill progress remain execution checks.
public fun needs_rebalance<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
): bool

/// Updates the order cap after checking the live bound market's prices and lot.
/// Risk administration remains available without healthy margin or positive NAV.
public fun set_max_order_notional<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    witness: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    account: &account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Deposits configured collateral into the active funding buffer without shares or fees.
public fun donate<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &mut clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    cash: Coin<Collateral>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Accepts a reviewed forced venue reduction without shutting down the vault.
/// Only RiskAdmin may acknowledge the change. Every number comes from the bound
/// venue; the caller supplies no replacement accounting. Funding settled here
/// is isolated from the historical change and booked normally. Recovery checks
/// prices and positive NAV without requiring margin for opening another trade.
/// This changes no share supply, admin cash, fees or lifecycle.
public fun rebaseline<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    witness: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    account: &account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &mut clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Settles due funding and reconciles the stored checkpoint with the venue,
/// with no priced operation attached and no lifecycle move. Any caller may
/// submit the bound objects; a binding failure aborts. An explainable funding
/// move is booked and emitted, and an interval the classifier cannot explain
/// leaves the accepted checkpoint standing and emits `CheckpointDrifted`.
public fun sync_health<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &mut clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Recovers all actual holder collateral only from an exactly settled bound account.
public fun finalize_shutdown<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: &mut clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Realizes profitable exposure only while cash margin is insufficient. The
/// core sizes one capped close and exact reopen, with no caller reward. Both
/// fills must complete, restore the original position and improve usable cash
/// by more than their cost. Withdrawals use a new quote in a later transaction.
/// Private entry and internal sharing preserve the maintenance PTB boundary.
entry fun realize_profit<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &TxContext,
)

/// Permissionless, policy-sized maintenance with no caller reward or trade parameters.
///
/// Ordinary maintenance runs at or below the reference gas price. A reduction
/// starting above the hard leverage cap may pay priority gas; holders bear the
/// venue's extra trading fee, and the plan stops once the hard cap is restored.
/// Private entry prevents a preceding venue session from supplying the shared market.
/// Shares the ClearingHouse internally, ending its use in this transaction.
entry fun rebalance<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &TxContext,
)

/// Permissionless bounded close-only progress, never caller-sized or dependent
/// on positive NAV. A live market is closed by price-limited orders; a market the
/// venue has paused only by the venue's own settlement, once it has closed the
/// market and enabled settlement prices; a frozen clearing house aborts every
/// venue call on its version check, so it is refused here until unfrozen.
/// Priority gas is allowed so closings can compete during congestion; holders
/// bear the venue's extra trading fee on any priority-priced fills.
/// Private entry prevents a preceding venue session from supplying the shared market.
/// Shares the ClearingHouse internally, ending its use in this transaction.
entry fun unwind<Product, Collateral>(
    vault: &mut vault::Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    account: &mut account::Account<Collateral>,
    registry: &registry::Registry,
    clearing_house: clearing_house::ClearingHouse<Collateral>,
    base_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    collateral_oracle: &price_feed_storage::PriceFeedStorage,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &TxContext,
)
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::orders`

Order placement for one operation: the sealed terms, the whole-lot sizing, the price limit of each order, each venue session, and the proof of every fill against the checkpoint.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/orders.move

#### Types

```move
/// The sealed terms every order of one operation is placed and proved under.
/// Package-internal; Move has no private structs.
public struct OrderTerms has copy, drop {
    is_ask: bool,
    reduce_only: bool,
    /// The whole-lot base one order may carry, sized by the core at the sealed pair.
    max_order_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    base_price: u64,
    collateral_price: u64,
    /// The execution bound the core fixed for the operation's orders; a
    /// rebalance order carries its own instead.
    bound: blast_boosts_core::policy::ExecutionBound,
}

/// What one whole-lot order proved: the base atoms filled and the raw quote
/// the session moved, already checked against the cap, the lot and the
/// execution bound.
public struct Fill has drop {
    filled: u64,
    filled_quote: u256,
}
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::package_admin`

Permanent shared custody for the adapter Publisher and UpgradeCap.  Authorization, activation and immutability take `AdminWitness<UpgradeAdmin>`, the upgrade role the core declares for every adapter. Receipt commit carries the native authorization proof instead. Custody itself stays package-local: this adapter's generation advances without touching the core, which is immutable and has no generation of its own.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/package_admin.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared, non-releasable adapter package authority.
public struct PackageAdmin has key {
    id: UID,
    custody: blast_admin::upgrade_custody::UpgradeCustody<blast_boosts_aftermath::BLAST_BOOSTS_AFTERMATH>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Validates the canonical adapter capabilities and seals them into custody.
///
/// `upgrade_custody::new` owns the complete provenance check: the Publisher must
/// belong to this package and the cap must be this package's never-upgraded one.
/// No later call re-reads those fields, because the sealed value cannot hold
/// anything else.
public fun wrap(publisher: Publisher, upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap, ctx: &mut TxContext)

/// Authorizes one exact adapter digest under the sealed cap's current policy.
/// Version-independent so the live UpgradeAdmin can repair a mismatched build.
public fun authorize_upgrade(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::UpgradeAdmin>,
    digest: vector<u8>,
): UpgradeTicket

/// Commits the receipt bound to this cap without changing the active generation.
///
/// Authorization, native upgrade and receipt commit complete in one transaction.
/// The receipt already proves authorization; repair finalization is version-independent.
public fun commit_upgrade(self: &mut PackageAdmin, receipt: UpgradeReceipt)

/// Activates the running successor in a follow-up transaction, only if its
/// compiled generation is exactly next. A mismatched build leaves the old
/// generation serving. The caller cannot choose the target generation.
public fun activate_upgrade(
    protocol: &mut blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::UpgradeAdmin>,
)

/// Irreversibly destroys native upgrade authority for this adapter.
/// The running code must match the active generation before giving up repair.
public fun make_immutable(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::UpgradeAdmin>,
)
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::snapshot`

Authenticated Aftermath capture: proves every source is the bound one, reads the raw checkpoint, and normalizes prices and equity into the adapter's units.

```move
/// One authenticated capture: the raw checkpoint, both oracle legs, the mark,
/// the position's economics, and whether the venue can serve a priced
/// operation. A priced caller consumes it through `into_observation`; a health
/// caller reads only its checkpoint.
public struct CapturedSnapshot has drop {

    position_base: u64,
    lot_size: u64,
    side: blast_boosts_core::policy::PositionSide,
    pending_order_count: u64,

    economics_valid: bool,
    base_price: u64,
    base_timestamp: u64,
```

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::vault`

Adapter-owned Vault: custody of the core state, the venue account, the share currency and the retained cash, plus the public surface that needs no venue object (issuance, shutdown begin and claim, administration). Every venue-touching operation is driven by `operations`; this module never reads the venue, advances a checkpoint or completes a core plan.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/vault.move

#### Types

```move
/// One issued Boost currency before its venue account exists.
///
/// `issue` creates it and `operations::initialize` must consume it in the same
/// transaction: it has no abilities, so an issuance that is not activated cannot
/// be stored or shared, and a failed activation rolls the currency back too.
public struct VaultIssuance<phantom Product, phantom Collateral> {
    issuance: blast_boosts_core::state::Issuance<Product>,
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
    metadata_cap: MetadataCap<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
}

/// Shared adapter custody for one Boost currency, its core state and its venue account.
///
/// This adapter defines `Vault<Product, Collateral>`, so it can issue the corresponding
/// non-OTW currency through Coin Registry. The nested core state has private
/// fields and can change only through core mutation functions. A Vault exists
/// only from activation on, so every field below is always present; the share
/// caps hang off `id` as dynamic object fields.
public struct Vault<phantom Product, phantom Collateral> has key {
    id: UID,
    state: blast_boosts_core::state::State<Product>,
    /// The bound account's identity, last accepted checkpoint and admin authority.
    venue_account: venue_account::VenueAccount,
    /// The seed shares minted to the burn address at activation; never redeemable.
    locked_shares: u64,
    /// Earned admin fee collateral, held natively and never sent to the venue.
    admin_cash: Balance<Collateral>,
    /// Recovered holder collateral after finalization, never mixed with admin cash.
    terminal_cash: Balance<Collateral>,
}

/// Dynamic-object-field key for one Vault's share mint authority.
public struct TreasuryKey<phantom Product>() has copy, drop, store;

/// Dynamic-object-field key for one Vault's metadata authority.
public struct MetadataKey<phantom Product>() has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Issues one leverage currency and the issuance that `operations::initialize`
/// turns into its Vault in the same transaction.
///
/// `Product` is the currency's identity: `Vault<Product, Collateral>` names the coin and
/// Coin Registry admits each type once. Any non-primitive type may serve; the
/// Vault issuer role is the only authority. The adapter generation is checked
/// before Coin Registry mutation. Package custody is not an input:
/// `package_admin` seals a validated Publisher and UpgradeCap that no other
/// object can hold, so re-reading those fields here would prove nothing this
/// package does not already own.
public fun issue<Product, Collateral>(
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    admin_witness: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::VaultIssuer>,
    registry: &mut CoinRegistry,
    vault_policy: blast_boosts_core::policy::VaultPolicy,
    max_order_notional: u64,
    nav_cap: u64,
    symbol: String,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    icon_url: String,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): VaultIssuance<Product, Collateral>

/// Shares one activated adapter Vault.
public fun share<Product, Collateral>(self: Vault<Product, Collateral>)

/// Irreversibly stops ordinary operations without requiring venue or oracle
/// availability. The clock fixes when shutdown began; the close-only execution
/// bound `operations::unwind` prices under widens from that instant.
public fun begin_shutdown<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &mut Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::ShutdownAdmin>,
    reason: blast_boosts_core::lifecycle::ShutdownReason,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Burns native eligible shares for local terminal collateral; no venue or oracle access.
public fun redeem_shutdown<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &mut Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    shares: Coin<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
    minimum_collateral: u64,
    deadline_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Collateral>

/// Updates only future fee collections under the immutable issuance caps.
/// This local administrative edge requires neither venue objects nor prices.
public fun set_fees<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &mut Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    mint_fee_bps: u64,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    admin_share_bps: u64,
)

/// Replaces the NAV cap that bounds post-mint shareholder NAV.
/// This local administrative edge requires neither venue objects nor prices.
public fun set_nav_cap<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &mut Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    nav_cap: u64,
)

/// Replaces the Boost currency's display name, description and icon in Coin
/// Registry. The symbol is fixed at issuance; the registry has no setter for it.
/// At least one of the three must change, so every emitted update is a real one.
/// This local administrative edge requires neither venue objects nor prices.
public fun update_metadata<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::VaultIssuer>,
    currency: &mut Currency<blast_boost::BlastBoost<Product>>,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    icon_url: String,
)

/// Returns only earned local admin collateral, including during venue/oracle outages.
public fun withdraw_admin_fees<Product, Collateral>(
    self: &mut Vault<Product, Collateral>,
    protocol: &blast_boosts_aftermath::Protocol,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_boosts_core::blast_boosts_core::RiskAdmin>,
    amount: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Collateral>
```

#### Constants

- `SEED_SHARE_SCALE: u64 = 1_000`: Converts six-decimal seed NAV atoms to nine-decimal share atoms: `10^(share_decimals - collateral_decimals)` for the two precisions this adapter fixes.

### `blast_boosts_aftermath::venue_account`

Exact Aftermath account custody under its immutable venue binding: every deposit, allocation, order and withdrawal the Vault makes goes through here.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/boosts/aftermath_adapter/sources/venue_account.move

#### Types

```move
/// Immutable account, registry and clearing-house identities for one Aftermath
/// leverage account. Oracle storages and feeds follow the authenticated
/// market's current settings; their identities are not frozen at activation.
public struct Binding has copy, drop, store {
    account_object_id: ID,
    account_number: u64,
    registry_id: ID,
    clearing_house_id: ID,
}

/// The bound Aftermath account as the adapter knows it: its identity, the last
/// raw state it accepted, and the sole admin authority over it, paired once at
/// construction. Every venue mutation goes through this module's guarded
/// functions; the cap never leaves.
public struct VenueAccount has store {
    binding: Binding,
    checkpoint: checkpoint::Checkpoint,
    admin_cap: authority::AuthorityCap<authority::ACCOUNT, authority::ADMIN>,
}
```

## API reference: `blast_sui` (blastSUI and funSUI)

Not yet published on mainnet. Its interface may change before publication.

Events: every payload is emitted inside `blast_sui::blast_events::Event<T>`; filter on that type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EZeroAmount` | An operation requires a positive atomic coin amount. |
| 1 | `EInvalidShareAmount` | The number of shares exceeds the live blastSUI supply. |
| 2 | `EZeroBlastShares` | A positive SUI deposit rounded down to zero blastSUI shares. |
| 3 | `EZeroSuiRedemption` | A positive blastSUI redemption rounded down to zero SUI. |
| 4 | `EInvalidPackagePublisher` | The supplied Publisher was not claimed by this package's canonical module. |
| 5 | `EUnwindOnly` | The validator left the active set, so the vault accepts redemptions only. |
| 6 | `EValidatorNotActive` | The fixed validator is not in the active validator set. |
| 7 | `ENonzeroInitialSupply` | A treasury cap entering vault custody already has supply. |
| 8 | `ESlippageExceeded` | The output is below the caller's minimum. |
| 9 | `EInsufficientNativeRedemption` | Native redemption returned less SUI than the custody ledger's conservative valuation. |
| 10 | `EBlastAssetsDepleted` | blastSUI shares exist but blast custody holds no assets to price them. |
| 11 | `EBootstrapBelowNativeMinimum` | The protocol bootstrap deposit is below the native one-SUI stake minimum. |
| 12 | `ERedeemFeeAboveMaximum` | The requested redemption fee exceeds the immutable maximum. |
| 13 | `ERedeemFeeUnchanged` | The requested redemption fee equals the live rate. |
| 14 | `EFunBackingBelowSupply` | Fun custody's conservative assets fell below the funSUI supply. |
| 15 | `EStaleExchangeRate` | The staking pool has no exchange-rate entry for the current epoch. |
| 16 | `EBlastDepositBelowNativeMinimum` | A blastSUI deposit is below the native one-SUI staking minimum. |
| 17 | `EBlastDepositNotActive` | A blastSUI deposit receipt has not reached its native activation epoch. |
| 18 | `EWrongReceiptVault` | A blastSUI deposit receipt belongs to another vault. |
| 19 | `EWrongReceiptPool` | A blastSUI deposit receipt contains stake from another validator pool. |
| 20 | `EZeroSuiAfterFee` | The blastSUI redemption fee consumed the complete atomic payout. |
| 21 | `EWrongDelegationPool` | Native delegation returned stake from a pool other than the vault's immutable pool. |
| 22 | `EMissingPackageCapability` | PackageAdmin cannot be shared before every required capability is attached. |
| 23 | `EPackageCapabilityAlreadyExists` | PackageAdmin already owns a capability object of this exact type. |

### `blast_sui::blast_sui`
