
### `blast_sui::blast_sui_domain`

Blast SUI's administration roles in the shared Blast ACL.  A role is a type. An `AdminCap` holding `Role` signs in to `AdminWitness<Role>`, and a function's witness parameter names the one role it accepts, so a role from any other package is a different type and cannot reach these operations.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/blast_sui_domain.move

#### Types

```move
/// Attaches package capabilities and authorizes, cuts over, restricts, or seals an upgrade.
public struct UpgradeAdmin {}

/// Sets the blastSUI redemption fee.
public struct FeeAdmin {}
```

### `blast_sui::blast_sui_package`

Canonical package provenance witness and the shared cutover that prevents stale package generations from mutating protocol state.  The generation value, its checked arithmetic, and its replay event belong to `blast_admin::operational_version`; `init` seeds the value from the one-time witness before claiming the Publisher with it, so no other package can create this package's generation. This module owns only the canonical shared container and the two compiled constants that identify this bytecode and the bytecode a governed upgrade cuts over to.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/blast_sui_package.move

#### Types

```move
/// One-time witness: it seeds the package generation and claims this package's Publisher.
public struct BLAST_SUI_PACKAGE() has drop;

/// Singleton operational package generation.
public struct PackageVersion has key {
    id: UID,
    generation: blast_admin::operational_version::OperationalVersion<BLAST_SUI_PACKAGE>,
}
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: Current package generation accepted by every protected mutation.
- `NEXT_PACKAGE_VERSION: u64 = 2`: The generation this bytecode hands over to in a governed upgrade.

### `blast_sui::constants`

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `basis_points_denominator: u64 = 10_000`: Denominator for protocol rates expressed in basis points.
- `default_redeem_fee_bps: u64 = 2`: blastSUI redemption fee a new vault starts with.
- `max_redeem_fee_bps: u64 = 100`: Immutable ceiling for the blastSUI redemption fee.
- `package_digest_length: u64 = 32`: Exact byte length of a Sui package digest.
- `native_min_stake_mist: u64 = 1_000_000_000`: Smallest SUI amount the native validator set accepts as one new stake request.  It is also the minimum protocol bootstrap deposit: a smaller bootstrap could not be delegated and would leave blast custody idle.
- `max_pending_stakes: u64 = 3`: Most pending native receipts one custody ledger holds at once.  Same-epoch requests join the newest receipt, refresh drains every arrived receipt at the first current-rate epoch, and delegation is gated by that same current-rate proof, so at most two receipts — one buffer-deferred and one current-epoch — can coexist. Three carries one slot of slack, and `stake_idle` skips delegation instead of aborting when the ledger is full, so an unexpected third receipt costs deferred yield, never a user abort.
- `native_redemption_rounding_margin: u64 = 30`: Extra MIST requested from one native FungibleStakedSui redemption.  Native redemption floors the pool's total SUI value, then floors the principal and reward portions separately, so redeeming `v` pool tokens returns at least `floor(v * sui / tokens) - 3` MIST at the current rate. Requesting ceil pool tokens for `amount + 3` therefore funds `amount`. The constant carries ten times that proven bound: the vault calls the live system package, and headroom keeps exact redemption alive if a system upgrade drifts native rounding by a few MIST. Over-requested residue stays liquid in custody. An unbounded rate decrease is not a rounding drift and still fails closed.
- `fun_rounding_reserve_mist: u64 = 100_000_000`: Protocol-funded fun exit and rounding reserve, in MIST.  Native conversion floors pool tokens and a full active-position redemption loses up to the redemption margin, so fun custody can fall a few MIST below the funSUI supply between rewarded epochs. The reserve absorbs those losses so exact 1:1 redemption never needs blast custody. One tenth of a SUI also makes adversarial depletion through repeated native rounding impractical.
- `fun_exit_low_water_mist: u64 = 2 * native_redemption_rounding_margin!()`: Buffer at which active fun stake is unwound before another redemption can exhaust backing.  One redemption can lose at most the native margin. Keeping twice that amount lets a partial redemption and the protective unwind each absorb it.

### `blast_sui::custody`

One ledger of native SUI custody delegated to the vault's fixed staking pool.  A ledger holds liquid SUI, up to `max_pending_stakes` pending `StakedSui` receipts — each worth exactly its principal until conversion, ordered by strictly increasing activation epoch because same-epoch requests join — and at most one active `FungibleStakedSui` of the fixed pool. `active_sui` is the conservative SUI valuation of the active tokens: the floor value at the last applied pool exchange rate, reduced by exact native output between refreshes. The vault owns the applied rate; a ledger never reads the pool.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/custody.move

#### Types

```move
/// One internal native-asset ledger with liquid, pending, and active stake layers.
public struct Custody has store {
    liquid_sui: Balance<sui::SUI>,
    pending_stakes: vector<staking_pool::StakedSui>,
    active_stake: Option<staking_pool::FungibleStakedSui>,
    active_sui: u64,
}
```

```move
/// An owned blastSUI deposit that has not entered vault custody or coin supply.
```

### `blast_sui::events`

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/lib/events.move

#### Types

```move
/// Final native custody buckets of one ledger after a completed transition.
///
/// Conservative ledger backing is `liquid_sui + pending_sui + active_sui`, where
/// `active_sui` is the floor valuation of `active_pool_tokens` at the last
/// applied exchange rate less exact native output since.
public struct PoolCustody has copy, drop {
    liquid_sui: u64,
    pending_sui: u64,
    active_pool_tokens: u64,
    active_sui: u64,
}

/// The pool exchange-rate entry the vault last observed and applies to both ledgers.
///
/// `epoch` is the entry's table key; `sui_amount` and `pool_token_amount` are
/// the native primitives. A refresh in an epoch without an entry (safe mode)
/// keeps the previous entry, so `epoch` may trail the transaction epoch.
public struct ExchangeRate has copy, drop {
    epoch: u64,
    sui_amount: u64,
    pool_token_amount: u64,
}

/// Final custody and supply snapshot of both ledgers after a completed transition.
public struct VaultCustody has copy, drop {
    fun_custody: PoolCustody,
    blast_custody: PoolCustody,
    exchange_rate: ExchangeRate,
    fun_supply: u64,
    blast_supply: u64,
}
```

#### Events

```move
/// Emitted after an active admin attaches one capability object to PackageAdmin.
public struct PackageCapabilityAdded has copy, drop {
    package_admin_id: ID,
    capability_id: ID,
    capability_type: TypeName,
}

/// Emitted after the single-validator vault is created from the owner seed.
///
/// `fun_reserve_sui` is the protocol-funded fun safety reserve and
/// `bootstrap_sui` the blast bootstrap; their sum is the owner seed.
/// `locked_blast_sui` is the blastSUI minted one per bootstrap MIST and
/// transferred to `@0x0` in the same transaction: those shares can never be
/// redeemed, so their backing stays in blast custody permanently. No stored
/// field duplicates it; the treasury total supply and this fact are sufficient.
public struct VaultCreated has copy, drop {
    vault_id: ID,
    validator: address,
    pool_id: ID,
    fun_reserve_sui: u64,
    bootstrap_sui: u64,
    locked_blast_sui: u64,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after SUI enters fun custody one-to-one for funSUI.
public struct FunSuiMinted has copy, drop {
    sui_in: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after funSUI is burned one-to-one for SUI from fun custody.
public struct FunSuiRedeemed has copy, drop {
    fun_in: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after native stake is placed in a key-only blastSUI deposit receipt.
public struct BlastSuiDepositRequested has copy, drop {
    receipt_id: ID,
    vault_id: ID,
    pool_id: ID,
    principal_sui: u64,
    activation_epoch: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after an activated receipt enters blast custody and mints blastSUI.
public struct BlastSuiDepositClaimed has copy, drop {
    receipt_id: ID,
    vault_id: ID,
    principal_sui: u64,
    contributed_sui: u64,
    pool_tokens: u64,
    blast_out: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after a receipt is cancelled directly back to native SUI.
public struct BlastSuiDepositCancelled has copy, drop {
    receipt_id: ID,
    vault_id: ID,
    principal_sui: u64,
    returned_sui: u64,
}

/// Emitted after external SUI enters blast custody without minting blastSUI.
public struct BlastSuiDonated has copy, drop {
    sui_in: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after blastSUI shares are burned for their share of blast custody less the retained fee.
public struct BlastSuiRedeemed has copy, drop {
    blast_in: u64,
    gross_sui: u64,
    fee_sui: u64,
    net_sui: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after fun yield above the funSUI claim and reserve moved into blast custody.
public struct FunYieldSwept has copy, drop {
    liquid_sui: u64,
    pool_tokens: u64,
    swept_sui: u64,
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after the `FeeAdmin` changes the blastSUI redemption fee.
public struct RedeemFeeChanged has copy, drop {
    old_redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    new_redeem_fee_bps: u64,
}

/// Emitted after a permissionless refresh, sweep, and idle delegation pass.
public struct VaultSynced has copy, drop {
    custody: VaultCustody,
}

/// Emitted after both ledgers withdrew every native position because the validator left the active set.
public struct NativeStakeUnwound has copy, drop {
    custody: VaultCustody,
}
```

### `blast_sui::package_admin`

Permanent shared custody for package capabilities.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/package_admin.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared, non-releasable custody for package and update authority.
///
/// The reusable Publisher/UpgradeCap seal is the shared custody value; the
/// package-specific metadata and display capabilities remain dynamic object
/// children of this wrapper.
public struct PackageAdmin has key {
    id: UID,
    custody: blast_admin::upgrade_custody::UpgradeCustody<blast_sui_package::BLAST_SUI_PACKAGE>,
}

/// Type-derived key for a capability owned as a dynamic object field.
public struct CapabilityKey<phantom Capability>() has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Validates the fixed package capabilities and returns composable custody.
///
/// Deployment must call this before any raw-cap upgrade. The returned key-only
/// object must receive its required child capabilities before `share`.
public fun new(publisher: Publisher, upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap, ctx: &mut TxContext): PackageAdmin

/// Attaches one exact capability type under upgrade-admin authority.
public fun add_capability<Capability: key + store>(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
    capability: Capability,
)

/// Verifies required bootstrap capabilities and irreversibly shares custody.
public fun share(self: PackageAdmin)

/// Authorizes the exact package digest under the wrapped cap's current policy.
public fun authorize_upgrade(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
    digest: vector<u8>,
): UpgradeTicket

/// Commits the native receipt and advances one operational generation at once.
///
/// This is the only upgrade finalizer. Both mutations belong to the same
/// transaction, so a failure at either step rolls back the whole upgrade.
public fun commit_upgrade_and_advance(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &mut blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
    receipt: UpgradeReceipt,
)

/// Irreversibly narrows upgrades to additive changes.
///
/// Additive is the strictest exposed policy. A dependency-only restriction
/// is deliberately not exposed: it would foreclose adding a rescue entry
/// point if a defensive invariant abort ever froze the vault, while
/// additive still permits new code beside the frozen path.
public fun restrict_to_additive(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
)

/// Irreversibly destroys native upgrade authority for this package.
///
/// Publisher custody and every sealed child capability survive, so metadata and
/// display administration continue at the final operational generation.
public fun make_immutable(
    self: &mut PackageAdmin,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::UpgradeAdmin>,
)

/// Reports whether native upgrade authority remains sealed in custody.
public fun has_upgrade_cap(self: &PackageAdmin): bool
```

### `blast_sui::vault`

Single-validator custody of the 1:1 funSUI ledger and the blastSUI share ledger.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/blast_sui/sources/vault.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared owner of both treasury-cap child objects and the two native custody ledgers.
///
/// `fun_custody` backs only funSUI plus the protocol-funded rounding reserve,
/// and `blast_custody` backs only blastSUI, including the seed shares locked
/// at `@0x0` by `create`; both delegate only through `pool_id`.
/// blastSUI supply is therefore never zero after creation. `rate_epoch`,
/// `rate_sui`, and `rate_pool_tokens` cache the pool exchange-rate entry last
/// observed for a current epoch; a refresh in an epoch without an entry keeps
/// this conservative rate instead of scanning the table. `unwind_only` records
/// that the validator left the active set.
public struct Vault has key {
    id: UID,
    pool_id: ID,
    fun_custody: custody::Custody,
    blast_custody: custody::Custody,
    rate_epoch: u64,
    rate_sui: u64,
    rate_pool_tokens: u64,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
    unwind_only: bool,
}

/// Type-derived key for a treasury cap owned as a discoverable child object.
public struct TreasuryKey<phantom CoinType>() has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Creates and shares the vault from the owner seed, locking every seed share.
///
/// Both treasury caps must be empty. The pool's canonical validator must be
/// active and the pool must have an exchange-rate entry for the current epoch.
/// The seed must cover the fun rounding reserve plus a blast bootstrap of at
/// least the native minimum stake: the reserve enters fun custody as liquid
/// protocol capital that mints nothing, and the remainder enters blast custody,
/// mints one blastSUI share per MIST, and is delegated in this transaction.
/// The complete minted `Coin<BLAST_SUI>` is transferred to `@0x0` here, so
/// blastSUI supply stays permanently positive and the bootstrap backing can
/// never be redeemed. Nothing is returned; the treasury total supply and the
/// `VaultCreated` fact record the locked amount.
public fun create(
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    fun_cap: TreasuryCap<fun_sui::FUN_SUI>,
    blast_cap: TreasuryCap<blast_sui::BLAST_SUI>,
    owner_seed: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    pool_id: ID,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Mints funSUI one-to-one for SUI held in fun custody.
public fun mint_fun_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    sui_in: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<fun_sui::FUN_SUI>

/// Burns funSUI and returns exactly one MIST per unit from fun custody.
public fun redeem_fun_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    fun_in: Coin<fun_sui::FUN_SUI>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<sui::SUI>

/// Delegates SUI into a key-only receipt that remains outside vault custody.
///
/// The receipt is returned for transaction composition. It can be claimed for
/// blastSUI from its activation epoch, cancelled for native SUI at any time, or
/// placed in the caller's account through `deposit_receipt::keep`.
public fun request_blast_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    sui_in: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): deposit_receipt::BlastSuiDepositReceipt

/// Consumes an activated receipt and mints blastSUI at the current fair rate.
///
/// The receipt's native stake is external to blast custody until this call.
/// Existing holders therefore keep every reward earned before its activation.
public fun claim_blast_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    receipt: deposit_receipt::BlastSuiDepositReceipt,
    min_blast_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<blast_sui::BLAST_SUI>

/// Adds external SUI rewards to blast custody without minting blastSUI.
///
/// The donation increases assets per existing share, including the permanently
/// locked bootstrap shares. Anyone may donate; the caller receives no receipt,
/// shares, or withdrawal authority. Idle donations are delegated when a current
/// rate proves the pool is active and remain liquid otherwise.
public fun donate_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    sui_in: Coin<sui::SUI>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Burns blastSUI for its pro-rata share of blast custody less the retained fee.
///
/// Every redemption is partial against the total supply because the locked
/// seed shares can never be presented, so every redemption pays the current
/// `redeem_fee_bps`, which stays in blast custody. The quote uses the cached
/// conservative valuation, so the caller's `min_sui_out` is its protection
/// during a safe-mode epoch.
public fun redeem_blast_sui(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    blast_in: Coin<blast_sui::BLAST_SUI>,
    min_sui_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<sui::SUI>

/// Sets the blastSUI redemption fee for every later redemption.
public fun set_redeem_fee(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_sui_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    redeem_fee_bps: u64,
)

/// Permissionless refresh: unwinds an inactive validator, converts activated
/// stake, revalues both ledgers, sweeps fun yield, and delegates idle SUI.
public fun sync(
    self: &mut Vault,
    package_version: &blast_sui_package::PackageVersion,
    system_state: &mut sui_system::SuiSystemState,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

## API reference: `blast_admin` (Administration)

Live on mainnet. This reference matches the published source.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EInvalidSuperAdminCap` |  |
| 1 | `EInvalidAdminCap` |  |
| 2 | `EInvalidAdminRecipient` |  |
| 3 | `EAdminCapacityReached` |  |
| 4 | `EAdminRoleCapacityReached` |  |
| 5 | `EAdminRoleAlreadyGranted` |  |
| 6 | `EAdminRoleNotGranted` |  |
| 7 | `EInvalidSuperAdminRecipient` |  |
| 8 | `ESuperAdminTransferUnchanged` |  |
| 9 | `ENoPendingSuperAdminTransfer` |  |
| 10 | `ENotPendingSuperAdminRecipient` |  |
| 11 | `ESuperAdminTransferNotReady` |  |
| 12 | `ESuperAdminCapStillActive` |  |
| 13 | `EOperationalVersionMismatch` |  |
| 14 | `EOperationalVersionOverflow` |  |
| 15 | `EInvalidPackagePublisher` |  |
| 16 | `EInvalidUpgradeCap` |  |
| 17 | `EInvalidPackageDigest` |  |
| 18 | `EUpgradeCapUnavailable` |  |
| 19 | `EUpgradePolicyNotMoreRestrictive` |  |
| 20 | `EInvalidPackageMarker` |  |

### `blast_admin::blast_acl`

The one access-control list for every Blast package: one cold root and role-typed admins.  A role is a type that its consumer package declares. `AdminWitness<Role>` in a function signature is that function's role check, and a role from one package can never satisfy another package's signature.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/admin/sources/blast_acl.move

#### Types

```move
/// The shared singleton that lists the active root and every live administrator's roles.
public struct ACL has key {
    id: UID,
    super_admin_cap_id: ID,
    admins: VecMap<ID, VecSet<TypeName>>,
    /// The nominated next super admin: none until the transfer delay passes.
    pending_super_admin: blast_fun_timelock::Timelocked<Option<address>>,
}

/// Cold root authority for membership, roles, and delayed root replacement only.
public struct SuperAdminCap has key {
    id: UID,
}

/// Transferable, live-registry-checked administrator capability holding any granted roles.
public struct AdminCap has key, store {
    id: UID,
}

/// Transaction-local proof that a live `AdminCap` holding `Role` signed in.
public struct AdminWitness<phantom Role>() has drop;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Creates and delivers one live administrator that holds no role yet.
public fun grant_admin(
    self: &mut ACL,
    root: &SuperAdminCap,
    recipient: address,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Revokes one live administrator and all its roles without requiring possession of its cap.
public fun revoke_admin(self: &mut ACL, root: &SuperAdminCap, admin_cap_id: ID)

/// Adds `Role` to a live administrator.
public fun grant_role<Role>(self: &mut ACL, root: &SuperAdminCap, admin_cap_id: ID)

/// Removes `Role` from a live administrator; an administrator with no role signs in to nothing.
public fun revoke_role<Role>(self: &mut ACL, root: &SuperAdminCap, admin_cap_id: ID)

/// Deletes an active or already-revoked administrator cap and reports what it still held.
public fun destroy_admin_cap(self: &mut ACL, admin_cap: AdminCap)

/// Nominates `recipient` as the next super admin; it may accept once the transfer delay
/// passes. A new nomination replaces a pending one and restarts the delay.
public fun begin_super_admin_transfer(
    self: &mut ACL,
    root: &SuperAdminCap,
    recipient: address,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Cancels the pending root transfer at once, even after its delay has passed.
public fun cancel_super_admin_transfer(self: &mut ACL, root: &SuperAdminCap)

/// Accepts a ready root transfer as its nominated recipient and invalidates the old cap.
public fun accept_super_admin_transfer(self: &mut ACL, clock: &Clock, ctx: &mut TxContext)

/// Deletes a root capability only after an accepted replacement made it inert.
public fun destroy_retired_super_admin_cap(self: &ACL, root: SuperAdminCap)

/// Proves that `admin_cap` is live and holds `Role`; the witness type is what consumers require.
public fun sign_in<Role>(self: &ACL, admin_cap: &AdminCap): AdminWitness<Role>
```

#### Constants

- `MAX_ADMINS: u64 = 32`
- `MAX_ROLES_PER_ADMIN: u64 = 32`
- `SUPER_ADMIN_TRANSFER_DELAY_MS: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000`: The wait before a nominated super admin may accept the root.

### `blast_admin::blast_admin_events`

```move
    new_policy: u8,
}
```

### `blast_admin::operational_version`

Sealed operational-generation arithmetic for consumer-owned version containers.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/admin/sources/operational_version.move

#### Types

```move
/// Storable, package-typed generation value with construction and mutation sealed here.
public struct OperationalVersion<phantom PackageMarker: drop> has store {
    generation: u64,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Creates the initial operational generation from the consumer package's one-time witness, so
/// the value can only come into existence inside that package's initializer.
public fun new<PackageMarker: drop>(otw: &PackageMarker): OperationalVersion<PackageMarker>

/// Rejects bytecode whose private compiled generation differs from canonical state.
public fun assert_current<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &OperationalVersion<PackageMarker>,
    compiled_generation: u64,
)

/// Proves the proposed compiled generation is exactly next before other finalizer effects.
public fun assert_next<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &OperationalVersion<PackageMarker>,
    compiled_generation: u64,
)

/// Advances only when the consumer's new compiled generation is exactly one greater.
///
/// `container` is the versioned object's own UID, so the emitted container ID is one the caller
/// holds.
public fun advance<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut OperationalVersion<PackageMarker>,
    container: &UID,
    compiled_generation: u64,
)
```

#### Constants

- `INITIAL_GENERATION: u64 = 1`

### `blast_admin::upgrade_custody`

Sealed custody and native transitions for one consumer package's framework capabilities.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/admin/sources/upgrade_custody.move

#### Types

```move
/// Storable custody value whose capabilities never leave it: the Publisher is readable by
/// reference and the UpgradeCap acts only through the named transitions below.
public struct UpgradeCustody<phantom PackageMarker: drop> has store {
    publisher: Publisher,
    upgrade_cap: Option<UpgradeCap>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Validates an original package's Publisher and never-upgraded cap before sealing both.
public fun new<PackageMarker: drop>(
    custodian_id: ID,
    publisher: Publisher,
    upgrade_cap: UpgradeCap,
): UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>

/// Reports whether native upgrade authority remains sealed in custody.
public fun has_upgrade_cap<PackageMarker: drop>(self: &UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>): bool

/// Borrows the sealed Publisher for provenance-gated framework features such as Display and
/// TransferPolicy. Every framework path that moves or burns a Publisher takes it by value, so a
/// reference cannot end custody; the consumer wrapper decides who may call this.
public fun publisher<PackageMarker: drop>(self: &UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>): &Publisher

/// Authorizes exactly one 32-byte package digest under the cap's current policy.
public fun authorize_upgrade<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>,
    custodian_id: ID,
    digest: vector<u8>,
): UpgradeTicket

/// Commits a native receipt into the same sealed capability that authorized it.
public fun commit_upgrade<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>,
    custodian_id: ID,
    receipt: UpgradeReceipt,
)

/// Irreversibly narrows compatible policy to additive-only upgrades.
public fun restrict_to_additive<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>,
    custodian_id: ID,
)

/// Irreversibly narrows compatible or additive policy to dependency-only upgrades.
public fun restrict_to_dependency_only<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>,
    custodian_id: ID,
)

/// Irreversibly destroys native upgrade authority while preserving Publisher custody.
public fun make_immutable<PackageMarker: drop>(
    self: &mut UpgradeCustody<PackageMarker>,
    custodian_id: ID,
)
```

#### Constants

- `PACKAGE_DIGEST_LENGTH: u64 = 32`
- `INITIAL_NATIVE_VERSION: u64 = 1`: The framework stamps a freshly published package's `UpgradeCap` with version one.

## API reference: `blast_aftermath_dao_presale` (Aftermath DAO-pool presale migrator)

Live on mainnet, published from an earlier revision. The source documented here has changed since; until it is republished, confirm signatures against the live package.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

### `blast_aftermath_dao_presale::blast_aftermath_dao_presale`

A one-off `blast_presale` migrator built for a partner. The `AdminCap` creates each sale with the Aftermath pool-creation capability of its LP coin, which stays bound to that sale. Anyone may then migrate the funded sale into a 50/50 Aftermath weighted pool wrapped in Aftermath's DAO-fee pool, which pays a 2% fee on every swap, deposit, and withdrawal straight to the partner treasury. The treasury also receives each sale's `PresaleCap` and each DAO-fee pool's owner cap, with which it may change that pool's fee or recipient; the sale's LP is locked forever.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/vendors/aftermath_dao_presale/sources/blast_aftermath_dao_presale.move

#### Types

```move
/// Sealed migrator identity a sale fixes when `new` starts it. Only this module constructs it, so
/// only `migrate` can release that sale's liquidity.
public struct Witness() has drop;

/// The package's only administrator, sent to the publisher at publication. Its one power is
/// creating sales through `new` and `finalize`.
public struct AdminCap has key, store {
    id: UID,
}

/// Shared reservation of one sale's Aftermath pool creation: the `CreatePoolCapV2` of the fresh LP
/// coin `Lp`, which only `migrate` of the sale `presale_id` can consume. A sale `new` started but
/// finalized directly in `blast_presale` has none, so it can never migrate and refunds after its
/// LP deadline.
public struct PoolCreation<phantom Lp> has key {
    id: UID,
    presale_id: ID,
    create_pool_cap: pool::CreatePoolCapV2,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a presale that migrates through this module. Its pool's weights and fees are this
/// module's constants, so the sale carries no pool terms. The sale is set like any other, then
/// finalized only through this module's `finalize`, which reserves its pool creation. The
/// `CreationPolicy` must allow `Witness`.
public fun new<SaleToken, Quote>(
    _: &AdminCap,
    package_version: &blast_presale::blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<SaleToken>,
    creation_policy: &blast_presale::creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    fee_policy: &blast_presale::fee_policy::FeePolicy,
): blast_presale::blast_presale::PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>

/// Finalizes a sale `new` started, sends its `PresaleCap` to the treasury, and shares a
/// `PoolCreation` binding `create_pool_cap`, minted by the fresh LP coin `Lp`, to it. Every LP fee
/// its pool pays reaches the treasury, so this sets the sale's LP-fee split to name the treasury as
/// its only recipient. The initializer must be one `new` started: another migrator's sale could
/// never consume the pool creation.
public fun finalize<Lp, SaleToken, Quote>(
    _: &AdminCap,
    package_version: &blast_presale::blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    initializer: blast_presale::blast_presale::PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    currency: &mut Currency<SaleToken>,
    create_pool_cap: pool::CreatePoolCapV2,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): blast_presale::blast_presale::Presale<SaleToken, Quote>

/// Anyone may migrate a funded sale `finalize` created, consuming the `PoolCreation` bound to it: it
/// seeds a 50/50 Aftermath pool with all of the sale's LP tokens and Quote, wraps it in a DAO-fee
/// pool paying the treasury, shares that pool, sends its owner cap to the treasury, and locks the
/// LP at `BURN_ADDRESS`.
public fun migrate<Lp, SaleToken, Quote>(
    sale: &mut blast_presale::blast_presale::Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_presale::blast_presale_package::PackageVersion,
    pool_creation: PoolCreation<Lp>,
    fee_policy: &blast_presale::fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    pool_registry: &mut pool_registry::PoolRegistry,
    dao_fee_version: &version::Version,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)
```

#### Events

```move
/// `finalize` reserved the sale `presale_id`'s Aftermath pool creation for the LP coin `Lp` in the
/// shared `pool_creation_id`, which its migration consumes.
public struct PoolCreationReserved<phantom Lp, phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    pool_creation_id: ID,
}

/// A sale migrated into the Aftermath pool `pool_id`, which traders reach through the shared
/// DAO-fee pool `dao_fee_pool_id`. The treasury holds that pool's owner cap `owner_cap_id`, and
/// `BURN_ADDRESS` holds the LP coin `lp_coin_id`, which locks the sale's `lp` units forever.
public struct Migrated<phantom Lp, phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    pool_id: ID,
    dao_fee_pool_id: ID,
    owner_cap_id: ID,
    lp_coin_id: ID,
    lp: u64,
}
```

#### Errors

| Constant | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EPoolMismatch` | 0 | The Aftermath pool must hold every sale token and Quote unit the presale released. |
| `EDaoFeePoolMismatch` | 1 | The DAO-fee pool must charge this package's fee and pay the treasury. |
| `EWrongPresale` | 2 | The pool creation is bound to a different presale. |
| `EWrongMigrator` | 3 | Only a sale this package's `new` started can be finalized here. |

#### Constants

- `TREASURY: address = @0x37cf46b499f740e653644bd2f7a8ed97f248e8b3c69d5d12c97d7845a54c0cd8`: Receives every sale's `PresaleCap` and every pool's DAO fees and owner cap.
- `BURN_ADDRESS: address = @0x0`: Owns every pool's LP coin. No one can sign for the zero address, so nothing it owns can ever be used in a transaction again.
- `DAO_FEE_BPS: u16 = 200`: The DAO fee, 2%, that Aftermath sends to the treasury from every swap, deposit, and withdrawal until the owner cap changes it.
- `HALF_WEIGHT: u64 = 500_000_000_000_000_000`: Each coin's weight: half of Aftermath's `1e18` fixed-point one.
- `FLATNESS: u64 = 0`: Selects Aftermath's uncorrelated weighted-product curve.
- `BASE_SWAP_FEE: u64 = 100_000_000_000_000`: Aftermath's minimum base swap-in fee, 0.01% in its `1e18` unit; it rejects zero. This part compounds into the locked LP.
- `POOL_NAME: vector<u8> = b"Blast Presale Pool"`
- `ALL_BPS: u64 = 10_000`: The whole LP-fee split, which the treasury takes.
